tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rje rang byung rdo rje'i thugs dam bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag bzhugs so/// /

"$ ༄༅// 'phags pa'i bstod pa mtha' brtson grub kyis mdzad pa/ lha las phul du byung ba'i bstod pa slob dpon bde byed bdag pos mdzad pa dang*/ de gnyis kyi 'grel pa shes rab go chas mdzad pa rnams rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ nang par legs par sad pa'i bstod pa 'gyur mi 'dra ba gnyis shri ha ri sha'i dhe bas mdzad pa dang*/ bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa las/ dad pa las spobs pa bskyed pa lags pa'i le'u bcu gsum tshang ba slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa dang rin chen mchog dang dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ de'i 'grel pa dga' byed snyan pas mdzad pa shākya blo gros kyi 'gyur/ bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa la slob dpon phyogs glang gis mdzad pa spel mar bstod pa le'u bcu gsum pa bsod nams bzang po'i 'gyur/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa/ bsngags par 'os pa bsngags pa las srid pa las skyob par bstod pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du grub pa zhes bya ba'i bstod pa/ stobs dang mi 'jigs pa la bstod pa/ gsung rnam par dag pa la bstod pa/ rtsod pa mi mnga' bar bstod pa/ ljags la bstod pa/ sku'i phyogs gcig la bstod pa/ tshangs pa dang mthun par gsung la bstod pa/ phan pa mdzad par bstod pa/ lan mi lon par bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal ba'i bstod pa rnams slob dpon ma ti tsi tras mdzad pa/ dpal brtsegs lags pa'i 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das la dad pas smre ba'i bstod pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mtshan la bstod pa/ dpe la bstod pa/ gcig las 'phros pa'i bstod pa rnams/ slob dpon ma ti tsi tras mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i bstod pa slob dpon chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa/ chos sku'i yon tan thun mongs ma yin pa la bstod pa 'phags pa thog med kyis mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ de kho na nyid la bstod pa dpal gyi go chas mdzad pa shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/

thams cad mkhyen pa dbang phyug chen po zhes bya ba'i bstod pa bde byed bdag po dang*/ mtho brtson grub rjes mdzad pa/ bdud btul ba la bstod pa rab dga'i lhas mdzad pa/ yon tan mtha' yas par bstod pa slob dpon dkon mchog bsangs kyis mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa slob dpon phyogs kyi glang pos mdzad pa/ de'i bsdus tshig le'ur byas pa rnams/ ye shes sde dang dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ bshags pa'i bstod pa tsan tra go mis mdzad pa dang*/ de'i 'grel pa sangs rgyas zhi bas mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ tshigs su bcad pa brgyad pa'i bstod pa dge bsnyen mtha' yas mdzad pa/ rgyal ba brgyad pa'i bstod pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ sangs rgyas dbang bskur ba'i bstod pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis la bstod pa/ dmyal ba nas 'don pa'i bstod pa/ slob dpon klu grub kyis mdzad pa/ pa tshab kyi 'gyur ba la nor rgyun mas bstod pa/ nyi ma rgyan mtshan gyi 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la bstod pa/ dkon mchog 'bangs kyis mdzad pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bstod pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi bstod pa rnams rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ skal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong la bstod pa skal bzang rgyan 'phreng paṇa chen shākya shris mdzad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bstod pa slob dpon dkon mchog 'bangs kyi mdzad pa/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i bstod pa 'phags pa sgra gcan 'dzin bzang pos bstod pa/ khe'u rgad yon tan dpal gyi 'gyur/ sbyor bzhi'i lha la bstod pa ratna ghi dhis mdzad pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa'i tshogs lnga bcu rtsa drug dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 'jam dpal rnon po la bstod pa gsungs pa/ 'jam dpal gyi don dam pa'i bstod pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal gyi dbyangs la bstod pa dbu mtha' yas pa'i 'a khor lo phyogs kyi glang pos mdzad pa/

gu gum gzhon nu'i bstod pa seng ge mi g.yo bas mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ 'jam dpal gyi bstod pa byin rlabs dang bcas pa tsan tra go mis mdzad pa chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ 'jam dpa' ye shes yon tan bzang po'i bstod pa rdo rje mtshon chas mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'jam dbyangs la bstod pa gser gyi 'phreng ba ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig pa la bstod pa/ ma tis mdzad pa/ 'jam dbyangs kyi bstod pa 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa gzhon nu 'bar gyi 'gyur/ 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi smre sngags dang bcas pas bstod pa/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ gsung gi dbang phyug gi bstod pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ 'jam dpal la khye'u bcu drug gis bstod pa/ bu mo brgyad kyis bstod pa mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la bstod pa/ so ma shris mdzad pa/ gzhon nu 'od kyi 'gyur/ ngag gi dbang phyug gtso 'khor lnga pa'i bstod pa/ thig le bum pas mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal gyi khyad par gyi bstod pa a nan ta shris mdzad pa chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 'jam dbyangs la bstod pa tsant+ra go mis mdzad pa gnyan chung dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi bstod pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la bstod pa ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la bstod pa ti pam̐ ka ra shri dzña nas mdzad pa brtson 'grus seng ge'i 'gyur/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la mtshan nyid bsdus pa'i sgo nas bstod pa birya tsan tras mdzad pa/ phyag na rdo rje'i bstod pa thung ngu 'khor lo chen po'i lha tshogs la bstod pa dza ba ri pas mdzad pa chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la bstod pa bram ze ma ni badzras mdzad pa rab zhi bshes gnyen gyi 'gyur/ spyan ras gzigs kyi bstod pa brgya pa snyan ngag mkhan chen po shri badzra de bas mdzad pa/

shong ston gyi 'gyur/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi bstod pa tsarya dhi pa zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ nor bu gling gi thugs rje chen po lha lnga la bstod pa rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ spyan ras gzigs 'khor dang bcas pa la bstod pa tsan tra go mis mdzad pa/ 'jig rten mgon po'i bstod pa yid 'phrog sdig 'joms tsan tra go mis mdzad pa/ dhā na shi la'i 'gyur/ 'jig rten dbang phyug la bstod pa/ dge slong ma dpal mos mdzad pa/ rigs mi 'dra ba lnga/ don yod zhags pa'i dkyil 'khor la don zhags kyi sgo nas bstod pa dri ma med pa'i 'od/ don zhags lha lnga'i bstod pa e ra wa tis mdzad pa/ ba ri'i 'gyur/ don zhags lha lnga'i bstod pa/ tsan tra go mis mdzad pa/ thugs rje chen po la bstod pa tsan tra go mis mdzad pa/ thugs rje chen po la bstod pa smre sngags can zla ba grags pas mdzad pa/ seng ge sgra'i bstod pa ti la kas mdzad pa/ mal zho blo gros grags kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ dngos gzhi dkar chag gi rim pa la/ nang rig pa ston pa sngags dang*/ mtshan nyid gnyis las/ mchog rdo rje theg pa yin la/ de la rgyud sde chen po bzhi so so ba dang*/ spyi'i yan lag rnams las/ so so ba la rtsa ba'i rgyud dang*/ bshad pa'i rgyud dang*/ rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa'i 'grel pa/ dkyil chog bstod pa/ bsgrub thabs/ las tshogs dang bcas pa rnams las/ gsang sngags bla na med pa'i rgyud la/ gnyis su med pa'i rgyud dang*/ thabs kyi rgyud dang*/ shes rab kyi rgyud dang*/ de dag dang cha mthun gyi rgyud rnams las/ bla na med pa'i rgyud rnams kyi snying po nges pa'i don ji bzhin par ston pa gnyis su med pa dus kyi 'khor lo'i bskor rnams thog mar bzhugs pa ni/ (ka)pa la/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i bsdus pa'i rgyud dang*/ de'i 'grel pa spyan ras gzigs kyis mdzad pa dri ma med pa'i 'od/ stong phrag bcu gnyis pa'i bstod pa bzhugs/

(kha)pa la de'i smad sangs rgyas grags kyis bsgyur ba dang*/ mdor bsdus dang po'i bshad sbyor blo gros brtan pas bsgyur ba/ don dam pa'i bsnyen pa pad ma dkar pos mdzad pa zla ba mgon po'i 'gyur dbang gi rab tu byed pa'i 'grel pa dha ri ka pas mdzad pa shes rab grags kyi 'gyur/ dbang rab 'byed kyi 'grel pa bu ston kha ches bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs so/ (ga)pa la/ pad ma can zhes bya ba'i 'grel pa po ma dpe las mi gsal/ tha'i 'gyur/ dbang mdor bstan gyi rgya cher 'grel pa slob dpon dus zhabs kyi mdzad pa/ shes rab grags kyi 'gyur/ don dam pa bsdus mdor bstan gyi rgya cher 'grel nā ro pas mdzad/ yar lungs pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga dpa' bo'i yid du 'ong ba'i 'phreng ba dus zhabs chen pos mdzad pa/ la chings yon tan 'bar gyi 'gyur/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i bsgrub thabs yan lag bzhi pa dus zhabs chen pos mdzad pa/ gyi jo zla ba 'od zer gyi 'gyur/ dpal ldan sgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor yan lag bcu gcig dus zhabs kyis mdzad pa le'u bcu gcig pa/ shes rab grags kyi 'gyur/ dus kyi 'khor lo lhan cig skyes pa skad cig gis bskyed pa'i bsgrub thabs rol pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ chos rab kyis 'gyur/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rab gnas kyi cho ga dus 'khor zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo slob dpon dus zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga dus 'khor zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i bsgrubs thabs sa dhu bhu tras mdzad pa chos rab kyi 'gyur/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i ro bsreg gi cho ga sa dhu pu tras mdzad pa chos rab kyi 'gyur/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes mdzad pa/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po'i 'gyur/ snying po gsum gsal ba rgyal po grags pa bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa dang*/

de'i 'grel pa nor bu lta bu/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag dus zhabs chen pos mdzad pa gyi jo zla ba 'od zer gyi 'gyur/ sbyor ba yan lag drug gi 'grel pa sbas pa mig 'byed a ba dhu ti pas mdzad pa zla ba grags pa'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (nga)pa la sbyor ba yan lag drug gi man ngag dus 'khor zhabs pas gsungs pa/ bi pu ta tsan tra'i 'gyur/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa ma dpe las mi gsal/ nu pa ma rakṣi tas mdzad pa bi pu ta tsan tras bsgyur zhing bsod nams bzang pos bcos pa/ de'i ti ka nyi ma dpal ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ bi pu ta tsan tra'i 'gyur/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag 'khor lo gsum gyi rim pa nyi ma dang zla ba bsgrub pa/ ye shes kyi spyan bsgrub pa gnyis dus 'khor zhabs kyis mdzad pa ma dpe las mi gsal/ 'byor zla ba'i 'gyur/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i snying po rgyan zhes bya ba'i bsgrub thabs bram ze bsod snyoms pas mdzad pa/ gyi jo zla ba 'od zer gyi 'gyur/ nang gi snye ma bhi pu ta tsan tras pa de nyid kyi rang 'gyur/ ma dpe las mi gsal/ ka ras mdzad pa/ 'khor lo grags kyi 'gyur/ dus kyi 'khor lo la 'jug pa 'jig med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ dharma ghi rtis bsgyur zhing chos rjes dpal gyis zhus dag byas pas dus kyi 'khor lo ma dpe las mi gsal/ ba sangs rgyas grags kyis mdzad pa de nyid kyi 'gyur/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsis kyi man ngag kha che shākya shris mdzad pa/ nyi zla 'dzin pa'i nges pa shākya shris mdzad pa/ gza' lnga so so'i rkyang rtsis kyi man ngag kha che shākya shris mdzad pa/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstod pa rgyun chags pa legs pa'i grags pas mdzad pa/ 'dan ma tshul khrims seng ges bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/ de rnams ni rdo rje theg pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud gnyis su med pa dus kyi 'khor lo'i rim par phye ba'o// rnal 'byor chen po thabs rgyud kyi bskor la/

mtshan yang dag par brjod pa spang por byas nas bshad pas mtshan brjod dus 'khor lugs sgyu 'phrul drwa ba dang*/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskor rnams las/ lta ba gnyis med du ston pa sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i bskor la/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'grel pa bdud rtsi thig pa sgrol ma gsal ba le'u bcu gsum pa a nu pa ma rakṣi tas mdzad pa/ dharma kirti dang*/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i rnam par bshad pa/ mi'i dbang po grags pas mdzad pa/ sbal rdo rje rgyal po'i 'gyur/ mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa dri ma med pa'i 'od/ rgyal po pad ma dkar pos mdzad pa/ rtsa mi bsod snyoms pa chen po'i 'gyur/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'grel pa sngags kyi don snying po bsdus pa/ dus kyi 'khor lo bar grags pas mdzad pa/ sbal rdo rje rgyal po'i 'gyur/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa mdor bshad pa bdud rtsi thigs pa nyi ma dpal gyis mdzad pa/ chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i mngon par rtogs pa byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs kyis mdzad pa rnams bzhugs/ de dag ni rnal 'byor chen po pha bla na med pa thabs kyi rgyud rgyu 'phrul drwa ba gsal bar byed pa'i rim par phye ba'o// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskor la/ 'phags bskor dang*/ ye shes zhabs skor dang*/ sgeg pa rdo rje dang*/ kun dga' snying po'i bskor bzhi las/ 'phags pa yab sras kyis mdzad pa'i bskor la/ (ca)pa la gsang ba 'dus pa'i 'grel pa/ rgyud kyi bshad pa le'u bco brgyad pa/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ stong phrag dgu pa gzhon nu tshul khrims kyis bsgyur ba dang*/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga nyi shu/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur bzhugs/ (cha)pa la gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga nyi shu pa/

slob dpon klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad pa/ pa tshab nyi ma grags kyi 'gyur/ zung 'jug gsal ba zhes bya ba// dbang gi bya ba sgra can 'dzin dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i 'gyur/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /slob dpon nag po bas mdzad pa/ 'gos lha btsas kyi 'gyur/ bsgrub pa'i thabs mdor byas pa/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ mdor byas kyi 'phreng ba rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa/ yan lag bcu gnyis pa karma badzras bsgyur ba/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed pa'i go rims mdo dang bsres pa'i/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyi mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'dus pa bsgrub pa'i thabs rnam par bzhag pa rim pa bzhi pa/ slob dpon klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgrubs thabs/ zla ba grags pas mdzad pa ma dpe las mi gsal/ dag gnyis pa/ klog skya gzhon nu 'bar gyis bsgyur zhing ba ri lo tshas bcos pa/ ro sreg gi cho ga 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod chog nag po pas mdzad pa/ ma ma dpe las mi gsal/ khro bo bcu'i gtor chog nag po pas mdzad pa/ sku gsung thugs rab du gnas pa'i cho ga mar me mdzad ye shes kyi mdzad pa/ rgya brtson 'grus seng ge'i 'gyur/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa lnga pa/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ rim pa lnga pa'i bshad pa nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ slob dpon klu'i byang chub kyi mdzad pa/ gzhon nu tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ mdor byas dang rim lnga'i dgongs 'grel zla ba'i 'od/ mi 'jigs pa'i 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa'i/ bi pu ta tsan tra'i 'gyur/ rim pa lnga'i dgongs 'grel/ nag po dam tshig rdo rjes mdzad pa/ tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba bzhugs/ (ja)pa la rim pa lnga'i bka' 'grel don gsal ba/

brtson 'grus bzang pos mdzad pa/ 'bro shes rab brtson 'grus kyi 'gyur/ rim pa lnga'i bka' 'grel/ slob dpon bhya ghir tis mdzad pa/ shākya brtson 'grus kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje bzlas pa rgya cher bshad pa/ shradha ka ra warmas mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ rim pa lnga pa'i don 'grel spyod pa bsdus pa'i sgron ma le'u bcu gcig pa/ slob dpon arya de bas mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ de'i rgya cher 'grel pa/ shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa mngon par byang chub pa'i man ngag 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa rnam par dbye ba/ a rya de bas mdzad pa/ 'gos lha btsas kyis 'gyur/ sems kyi sgrib sbyong 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa/ tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ rim pa khongs su bsdus ba'i man ngag klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad pa/ nyi ma grags kyi 'gyur/ las kyi mtha' rnam par 'byed pa/ klu'i blo yis mdzad pa/ chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/ byang chub sems 'grel klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rab zhi bshes gnyen gyis bsgyur zhing*/ nyi ma grags kyis gtan la phab pa/ byang chub sems kyi 'grel pa lhug pa/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ khu mdo sde'i 'gyur/ de'i 'grel

ma dpe las mi gsal/ de nyid kyis bsgyur ba/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i lam gyi rim pa'i man ngag bdud rtsi gsang ba yan lag drug pa/ sgra dbyangs bcu gcig pas mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ rgyan bdun rnam par 'gro ba/ shra ta ka ra warmas mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ tshul bzhi'i bshad pa/ arya de bas mdzad pa/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan dang*/ de'i 'grel pa slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa dang*/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i 'grel pa/ slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ bsgrub pa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa/ le'u bcu pa dzña na badzra mdzad pa/ lha btsun pa'i 'gyur/ rgyud la 'jug pa bsdus pa/ pra ta ka ra warmas mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgrub thabs kyi 'grel pa/ ta tha ga ta rakṣi tas mdzad pa/ ba ri'i 'gyur/ sgron ma gsal ba zhes bya ba'i rgya cher bshad pa/ dpal zla ba grags pas mdzad pa le'u bcu bzhi'i bstod pa yan chad/ rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/ (nya)pa la de'i smad le'u bcu bdun pa rdzogs pa dang*/ sgron gsal le'u dang po'i 'grel bshad/ slob dpon arya de bas mdzad pa/ sgron ma gsal bar byed pa'i/ bka' ba bsdus pa'i 'grel pa/ legs ldan byed kyis mdzad pa/ shākya brtson 'grus kyis 'gyur/ zla ba sgron ma zhes bya ba'i bshad pa'i tshig nges par 'byed pa'i bshad sbyar brgya pa bcu gsum pa/ ka ku ma da ras mdzad pa/ tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ sgron ma gsal bar byed pa'i dgongs pa rab gsal zhes bya ba'i ti ka stong phrag bcu drug pa/ bhya bha ghir dhis mdzad pa/ ku ma ra'i 'gyur le'u bzhi pa yan chad bzhugs/ (ta)pa la de'i 'jug yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ sgron ma gsal ba mdor bshad pa'i sa gcod snying gi me long ku ma ras mdzad pa/ shākya blo gros kyi 'gyur/ de rnams la ni gsang 'dus las skor zhes bya bar grags pa yin no// slob dpon ye shes zhabs rjes 'brang dang bcas pas mdzad pa'i bskor la/

rim pa gnyis pa'i de kho na nyid bsgom pa'i man ngag byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi zhal gyi lung dang ma dpe las mi gsal/ mdzes pa'i me tog birya pa tas mdzad pa/ mnga' bdag lha ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ rin po che'i ljon shing zhes bya ba/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa tsi lu pas mdzad pa lha ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis 'gyur ba/ le'u bcu gsum pa yan chad bzhugs/ (tha)pa la de'i 'jug yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi rnam par bshad pa/ tha ka nas mdzad pa/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i 'grel pa snyim pa'i me tog /shan ti pas mdzad pa le'u bcu bdun yan chod bzhugs/ (da)pa la de'i 'jug yongs su rdzogs pa/ 'gos lha btsas kyi 'gyur/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa'i bka' 'grel rgyal ba byin gyi mdzad pa/ shes rab ye shes kyis bsgyur zhing*/ dar ma grags kyis gtan la phab pa/ 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma'i 'grel pa gsang ba'i sgron ma/ snyan grags bzang pos mdzad pa/ smri ti'i 'gyur/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i 'grel pa dri med sbas pas mdzad pa'i rgyan le'u bco lnga pa yan chad bzhugs/ (na)pa la de'i 'jug rdzogs pa dang*/ rgyud phyi ma'i 'grel pa/ zla 'od kyis mdzad pa/ dar ma grags kyis 'gyur/ rgyud phyi ma'i rnam par bshad pa yang dag rigs byed sman zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis 'gyur/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i 'grel pa/ smri tis mdzad pa de'i rang 'gyur/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i 'grel pa slob ma la phan pa/ rab tu zhi ba'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ bshad pa'i rgyud rdo rje 'phreng ba'i 'grel pa/ a laṃ ka ka la sha de bas mdzad pa/ ga rod tshul khrims 'byung gnas kyis bsgyur ba ji snyed pa rnams bzhugs/ (pa)pa la lha mo bzhis zhus pa'i bshad pa man ngag rgyas pa/ smri tis mdzad pa rang 'gyur/ lha mo bzhis yongs su zhus pa'i rgyud kyi bshad pa/ ye shes snying pos mdzad pa smri ti'i 'gyur/

gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa/ mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ de nyid kyi 'grel pa shan ti pas mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ sbyor ba bdun pa zhes bya ba/ dbang bzhi'i rab du bya pa/ birya pa tas mdzad pa/ lha ye shes rgya mtshan gyi 'gyur/ dkyil 'khor bri ba'i cho ga bsod snyoms pas mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ dbang gi rab du byed pa sum brgya pa/ bam po gcig pa/ dga' ba'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ dharma ghirti'i 'gyur/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang bskur ba'i cho ga mdor bsdus pa/ ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa/ klog skya gzhon nu 'bar dang*/ chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ de kho na nyid bcu pa/ dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha sum bcu rtsa gnyis la bstod pa/ slob dpon mi gnas rdo rjes mdzad pa dang*/ lha bcu dgu la bstod pa/ mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa gnyis/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ zhal lung chung ba u rgyan gyi yul nas phyung ba/ sangs rgyas ye shes kyi bsgrub thabs kyi man ngag /bsgrub thabs kun tu bzang po sangs rgyas ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ kun tu bzang po'i bsgrubs thabs kyi 'grel pa/ dpal rdo rjes mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ bsgrub thabs kun tu bzang po zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa smri ti'i 'gyur/ de'i 'grel pa snying po'i snye ma kun tu bzang pos mdzad pa/ blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ kun tu bzang po'i bsgrub thabs kyi 'grel pa smri ti'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (pha)pa la gsang ba 'dus pa'i bsgrub thabs dngos grub 'byung ba'i gter/ birya pa tas mdzad pa/ lha ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ 'dus shing rtogs sla ba 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i bsgrub thabs/ pu n+ya shris mdzad pa/ 'dus pa'i bsgrubs thabs bsod snyoms pas mdzad pa/

rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ mi bskyod pa'i bsgrub thabs rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba'i bsgrub thabs/ dpe med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bsgrub mi bskyod rdo rje'i bsgrub thabs/ smri tis bsgyur ba/ bstan pa'i nor thams cad pa'i bsgrub thabs/ rad na dha kis mdzad pa/ dar ma grags kyis 'gyur/ rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga zla 'od kyis mdzad pa/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga ngag gi dbang phyug gis mdzad pa/ ba ri 'gyur/ a rga'i cho ga snang byed zla bas mdzad pa/ pradzña ghirti 'gyur/ rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga ye shes snang ba/ slob dpon snang byed zla bas mdzad pa/ dpal he ru ka'i bsgrub thabs sangs rgyas ye shes kyis mdzad pa dang*/ de'i 'grel pa dran pa ye shes grags pa'i 'gyur/ dga' ba'i bsgrub thabs/ rgyal ba byin gyis mdzad pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyug lha bcu dgu'i bsgrub thabs/ mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'dus pa'i ba par rtogs pa'i rim pa/ dhri baṃ ka ra kirtis mdzad pa/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga ye shes zhabs kyi o rgyan gyi yul nas spyan drangs nas mdzad pa smri ti'i 'gyur/ stangs stabs 'dug stabs kyi rim pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes kyi mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal rdo rje'i mchod chog dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ bi pu ta tsan tra'i 'gyur/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga rab 'jigs rdo rjes mdzad pa/ sho lo ka brgya bcu rtsa gsum pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ chu dbang gi bsgrub thabs/ sangs rgyas ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ gsang ba'i 'dzam bha la'i bsgrub thabs ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa dar ma yon tan gyi 'gyur/ u tsus ma'i bsgrub thabs sgeg pa rdo rjes mdzad pa/ dha na shi la'i 'gyur/ gtor ma'i cho ga chen po/

birya pa tas mdzad pa/ lha ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur rdzogs pa'i rim pa grol ba'i thig le/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa dang*/ de'i rnam par bshad pa bidya pa tas mdzad pa/ lha ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ mi shigs pa'i bsgrubs thabs rin po che zhes bya ba/ birya pa tas mdzad pa lha ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ bdag bsgrub pa'i thabs la 'jug pa ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur/ bdag gi don grub pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor gyi rim pa bidya pa tas mdzad pa lha ye shes rgyan mtshan gyi 'gyur/ ye shes zhabs lugs kyis 'dus pa'i yan lag drug pa/ sbyor ba yan lag drug gi snang ba'i rim pa/ snang mdzad rdo rjes mdzad pa g.yung drung 'od kyi 'gyur/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa zhes bya ba'i 'grel pa smri tis mdzad pa/ de kho na nyid snang ba rtsa 'grel/ ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa/ yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i bzhi pa le'u lnga pa nyis stong lnga brgya pa/ ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa/ de rnams ni sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi lugs rnams so// slob dpon sgeg pa rdo rjes mdzad pa ni/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i dgongs pa thams cad nye bar len pa'i 'grel pa/ bzhad pa rdo rjes mdzad pa/ bāai ro tsa nas bsgyur zhing*/ skad gsar bcad kyis bsabs pa/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i gleng bzhi bla ma'i man ngag gis bshad pa/ sgeg pa rdo rjes mdzad pa/ dpal bde ba chen po'i bsgrub thabs bzhad pa rdo rjes mdzad pa rnams bzhugs// (ba ma tsa tsha)rnams la dpal bde ba chen po'i rnam par bshad pa bhi ma la gar bas mdzad pa dang*/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i 'grel chen slob dpon kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa/ phra ras kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (dza)pa la gsang ba 'dus pa'i bka' bgrel/ slob dpon kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma'i le'u bco brgyad pa'i tshig dang don rgya cher 'grel pa/

bhi sha mi tras mdzad pa rnams te/ rnal 'byor chen po thabs kyi rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskor rim par phye ba'o// thabs rgyud kyi cha mthun gshin rje gshed dmar nag gi bskor las/ sgra nag gi skor la/ dpal gshin rje gshed nag po'i bka' 'grel/ dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa rgya cher 'grel pa/ mngon par mthong ba'i lam gyi sgron ma/ kris ṇaṃ la chen pos mdzad pa/ pradzña dzña na kirti'i rang 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed sgra nag po'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa rin po che'i sgron ma/ ratna a kar shan ti pas mdzad pa/ chos kyi shes rab 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud kyi bka' 'grel le'u bco brgyad pa/ gzhon nu zla bas mdzad pa rnams bzhugs/ (wa)pa la gshin rje gshed nag po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga slob dpon dpal 'dzin mdzad pa/ shes rab dang gzi bshid 'phags pa'i 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed sgra'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gshin rje gshed 'byung ba/ la li ta badzras mdzad pa/ cog gru shes rab bla ma'i 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i maṇḍal gyi cho ga slob dpon bsod snyoms pas mdzad pa/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga dang*/ chos sku snang ba zhes bya ba'i cho ga nag po pas mdzad pa la gsum/ pradzña shri gsum na girtis rang 'gyur du mdzad pa/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i bsgrub thabs dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa gnyis/ yon tan grags kyi 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i bsgrub thabs/ kun du bzang pos mdzad pa don yod rdo rje'i 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs/ bsod snyoms pa ka ma la rakṣis mdzad pa/ pra dzña dzña na girti'i 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i bsgrub thabs ku mu ta kha bye ba/ rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa/ chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i dus gsum mthar phyin pa'i bsgrub thabs/

kriṣṇa paṇḍi tas mdzad pa/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i bsgrub thabs/ mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i bsgrub thabs dang*/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i drag po'i las bsgrub pa/ nyi ma byed par grags pas mdzad pa/ 'gos lha btsas kyi 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i bsgrubs thabs/ 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ nag po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i bsgrub thabs/ la li ta badzras mdzad pa/ 'o ma bsgrub pa'i thabs/ dzi mu ta badzras pa ta las mdzad pa/ gshed nag 'khor lo'i man ngag rnams chos rab kyi 'gyur/ gshed nag gi sbyin sreg gi cho ga la li ta badzra mdzad pa/ 'chi bdag yi dwags rgyal po'i bsgrubs thabs/ gshin rje gshed la mchod pa'i kriṣṇa paṇḍi tas mdzad pa gshin rje gshed nag po'i mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa/ dpal rdo rje'i slos mdzad pa/ gshin rje gshed po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga dngos grub gyi tshul nges par bstan pa/ don yod zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo cho ga ka ma la ma has mdzad pa/ gshin rje gshed kyi bsrung ba'i 'khor lo mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa/ dpal gshin rje gshed gdong drug gi bskor la gshin rje gshed gdong drug la 'khor lo'i bsgrub thabs/ dhe ba a ka ra tsan tras mdzad pa/ shes rab bla ma'i 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed sgra bsgrub pa'i 'khor lo'i bsgrub thabs klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal gyi rtog pa dam rdzas gsang ba smad du bsgyur te ston pa'i cho ga gshin rje gshed rnam par snang mdzad kyi bsgrub thabs dang*/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi bsgrub thabs dang*/ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed kyi bsgrub thabs/ rdo rje rnon po'i bsgrub thabs/ tho ba gshin rje gshed kyi bsgrub thabs/ dbyug pa gshin rje gshed kyi bsgrub thabs/ pad ma gshin rje gshed shes rab bde ba can gyi bsgrub thabs/ ral gri gshin rje gshed kyi bsgrub thabs/

rdo rje sems bde spyod ma'i bsgrub thabs/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnal 'byor ma'i bsgrub thabs/ rdo rje bde rgyas dbyangs can ma'i bsgrub thabs/ rdo rje sems ma gāau ri'i bsgrub thabs rnams/ mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa/ pradzña shri dzña na'i rang 'gyur/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bskor la/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud mdor bshad pa/ rdo rje grub pas mdzad pa/ 'jigs byed kyi mdo mdor bshad pa/ so na shris mdzad pa/ 'jigs byed kyi rgyud kyi bka' 'grel/ slob dpon gzhon nu zla bas mdzad pa dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/ 'jigs byed kyi rgyud kyi bka' 'grel/ mi bskyod pas mdzad pa/ chos kyi bzang po dang*/ chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur zhing*/ 'o ru lo tstsha ba zhus te gtan la phab pa/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa bcu bzhi pa/ de nyid lnga'i bstod pa/ tshigs su bcad pa gsum pa/ 'jigs byed la bstod pa don yod rdo rjes mdzad pa/ zhang shes rab bla ma'i 'gyur/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi mtshan gyi bstod pa/ las kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa/ 'jigs byed kyi bstod pa la li ta badzras mdzad pa dang*/ 'jigs byed kyi bsgrub thabs paṇa ta shris mdzad pa/ zhang 'od shes rab bsod nams kyi 'gyur/ 'jigs byed kyi bsgrub thabs a sho ka shris mdzad pa/ chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'jigs byed kyi bsgrub thabs la li ta badzras mdzad pa/ shes rab bla ma'i 'gyur/ 'jigs byed kyi bsgrub thabs don yod rdo rjes mdzad pa/ 'jigs byed kyi bsgrub thabs grub pa'i slob dpon la li tas mdzad pa/ ma he zhal gyi bsgrub thabs/ dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ ba ri dharmā girti'i 'gyur/ 'jigs byed chen po'i bsgrub thabs/ dzña na a ka ras mdzad pa/ zla ba 'od zer gyi 'gyur/ 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i bsgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi mdzad pa ra rdo rje grags kyi 'gyur/

'jigs byed kyi bsgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/ shri bha tras mdzad pa ra rdo rje grags kyi 'gyur/ 'jigs byed kyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga a mo gha badzras mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal rdo rje zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga a mo gha badzras mdzad pa/ 'jigs byed kyi tshogs kyi 'khor lo ratna a ka ra shan ti pas mdzad pa rnams/ rdo rje grags kyi 'gyur/ tstshu tshun dha ra'i cho ga zhib mo bshad pa/ 'jigs byed kyi phyag mtshan gyi rnam dag bshad pa rnams ta tha ga ta rakṣi tas mdzad pa rnams la zho blo gros grags kyi 'gyur/ 'jigs byed kyi gtor ma'i cho ga la li tas badzras mdzad pa/ zhi ba'i las bdun dbye ba/ a mo gha badzras mdzad pa/ drag po las bdun gyi cho ga u rgyan bar grags pas mdzad pa'o/ dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i bskor la/ dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lha bcu gsum gyi bsgrub thabs/ grub thob kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba/ dpal 'dzin gyi mdzad pa/ chos rjes dpal gyi 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i bsgrub thabs bir ba pas mdzad pa dang*/ lhan skyes kyis bsgrub thabs bir ba pas mdzad pa chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed dmar po lhan skyes kyi bsgrub thabs/ rnam par snang mdzad bsrung bas mdzad pa/ rang byin rlabs pa'i man ngag dang bcas pa/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i mngon par rtogs pa/ blo gros bzang pos mdzad pa chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed dmar med rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas mdzad pa/ 'od gsal 'char ba'i man ngag bi ru pas mdzad pa/ de'i man ngag dang bcas pa chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i 'khor lo'i gsal bya/ gshin rje gshed kyi las tshogs 'khor lo'i de kho na nyid gsal bar byed pa gnyis/ dpyal chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi cho ga /dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i mchod pa'i cho ga dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/

lag pa'i mchod pa dha na shi la'i 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i mchod pa'i cho ga dang*/ gtor ma'i cho ga chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed kyi gtor ma'i cho ga dang*/ 'khrul 'khor gyi cho ga gnyis/ bir ba pas mdzad pa/ chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed kyi 'khrul 'khor gyi 'phreng ba/ bi ru pas mdzad pa/ dha na shi la'i 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed dmar po bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i de kho na nyid ces bya ba rang byin gyis brlabs pa'i man ngag shri bi ru pas mdzad pa/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i 'tsho ba'i de kho na nyid ces bya ba'i man ngag dar ban a tsaryas mdzad pa/ shin tu spros pa med pa'i de kho na nyid kyi man ngag /bhir ba pas mdzad pa rnams/ blo bo lo tstsha ba shes rab rin chen gyi 'gyur de rnams rnal 'byor chen po thabs kyi thabs rgyud/ gshin rje gshed nag 'jigs skor gsum dmar po dang bcas pa'i bskor rim par phye ba'o/ bla na med pa shes rab kyi rgyud la/ bde mchog yab yum dang dgyes pa rdo rje dang*/ gdan bzhi dang*/ sgyu ma chen mo dang cha mthun pa sangs rgyas thod pa lags pa dang*/ mnyam sbyor gyi bskor rnams las/ bde mchog gi bskor rnams la/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi bstod 'grel/ dpal phyag na rdo rjes mdzad pa stong brgyad brgya cog gru ting nge 'dzin bzang pos bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/ (zha)pa la bsgrub thabs kyi gleng bzhi zhes bya ba'i bka' 'grel/ la ba pas zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ 'gos lha btsas kyi 'gyur dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bsgrub thabs/ gnas pa'i man ngag thams cad rgya cher lha swas kyis mdzad pa/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bka' 'grel rgyal ba bzang pos mdzad pa/ gnyis ka'i bshad sbyor/ ta thā ga ta rakṣis tas mdzad pa/ dar ma blo gros kyi 'gyur/ dpal bde mchog bsdus pa rnam par bshad pa/

inta bo de'i zhal snga nas bshad pa rnams bzhugs/ (za)pa la 'khor lo sdom pa'i bka' 'grel rin po che'i tshogs dpal rgyal bka' zla bas mdzad pa ghu na shri'i gyur/ dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i 'grel pa dpa' bo yid 'ong*/ skal ldan grags pas mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bka' 'grel/ bha ba bha tras mdzad pa/ ba ri lo tstsha ba'i 'gyur/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi rnam 'grel yon tan ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas/ dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad pa rin chen grags kyi 'gyur/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bsdus don gyi 'grel pa/ sho lo ka stong brgyad brgya pa/ khu ston dngos grub kyi 'gyur/ he ru ka mngon 'byung rgyud kyi rgyal po yig ge nyung ngu zhes bya ba'i 'grel pa/ rim par phye ba bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pa'i bka' 'grel/ zla ba gzhon nus mdzad pa/ dar ma blo gros gyi 'gyur/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud kyi rgya cher 'grel/ rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa/ shes rab ye shes kyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/ ('a)pa la 'khor lo bde mchog rgya cher bshad pa'i tshig don rab du gsal ba/ dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor ma kun tu spyod pa'i bshad sbyar lnga brgya pa/ ta thā ga ta rakṣi tas mdzad pa/ dge slong dharma girti'i 'gyur/ gsang ba rdo rje rgyud kyi 'grel pa/ ḍom bi he ru kas mdzad pa/ shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur/ bde mchog 'byung ba'i rgyud kyi bka' 'grel nyis stong drug brgya pa/ ratna ra kṣi tas mdzad pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal bzang po'i rang 'gyur la/ chos rje dpal gyis bcos pa/ sdom pa'i rgyud chung ngu'i 'tshams sbyor/ sam ti gi rtis mdzad pa grags 'byor shes rab kyi 'gyur/ dpal sdom pa bshad pa nag po spyod pa bas mdzad pa/ 'od zer ston chos 'byung gi 'gyur/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i bka' 'grel de kho na nyid bstan par byed pa/ shes rab 'od zer gyis bsgyur ba/

dpal rdo 0* rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud kyis rnam par bshad pa/ bha ba bha tras mdzad pa le'u bcu drug yan chad/ 'gos lha btsas kyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/ (ya)pa la de'i 'jug yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'grel pa gru rdzing stong phrag brgyad pa/ pad ma badzras mdzad pa/ lo tsā ba dar ma yon tan gyis bsgyur ba la/ dpal mchog dang po'i rdo rje zhus dag byas pa/ le'u sum cu so lnga pa yan chad bzhugs/ (ra)pa la 'grel pa gru rdzing gi smad/ le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa 'grel pa dang*/ nges par brjod pa rgyud bla ma/ rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi 'grel pa/ snying po snang ba/ shu rang ka badzras mdzad pa/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi 'gyur/ bde mchog rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma/ dpal gsang chen pad ma zhes bya ba'i rgya cher 'grel pa/ longs spyod rdo rjes mdzad pa/ paṇa ṭi ta de nyid kyis bsgyur/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dbang gi bya ba mdor bsdus pa/ rdo rje dril bu zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ bde mchog dkyil chog rin po che rab tu gsal ba'i sgron ma/ la ba pas mdzad pa/ mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ bde mchog gi dkyil mchog nag po pas mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur la/ chos kyi dbang phyug gis zhu dag byas pa/ bde mchog gi cho ga yid 'ong phreng ba/ dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad pa/ bde mchog 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bhu ba blo ldan gyis mdzad pa rnams bzhugs/ (la)pa la bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba'i tshigs bcad dgu brgya pa/ rgyal ba bzang pos mdzad pa ba ri'i 'gyur/ rgyal po seng ge'i gdan gyis rnam par dag pa'i lam gyi dbang gi bya ba/ pradzña ghirtis bsgyur ba/ dbang gi rab du byed pa/ a bhya ka ra gu pa tas mdzad pa/ shes rab dpal gyi 'gyur/ dpal bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /bi pu ta tsan tra'i 'gyur/ dbang gi cho ga'i rim pa ratna shrīs mdzad pa/

ma dpe las mi gsal/ dbang gi cho ga mnyes pa'i snying po/ dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad pa ye shes rdo rje'i 'gyur/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rin po che dbang gi rgyal po'i mdzod ma dpe las mi gsal/ rdo rje'i 'gyur/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bstod pa don thams cad grub pa rnam dag gtsug gi nor bu/ ḍa ri ka pas mdzad pa rgya brtson seng dang*/ nyi ma rdo rje'i 'gyur/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i bstod pa rgyun chags stong dang brgyad brgya brgya bcu pa/ chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i bstod pa/ int+ra bo dhis mdzad pa/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i bstod pa/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi bstod pa/ shu rang ga ka pa shas mdzad pa bsod nams bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la bstod pa/ rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i 'khor lo bsdus pa'i bstod pa/ dha ri ka pas mdzad pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la bstod pa rin chen sgyu 'phrul sbyin pa/ rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad pa/ chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur// 'khor lo sdom pa'i bstod pa me tri pas mdzad pa/ bde mchog 'khor lo'i bstod pa/ bam ga lar jo bos zhal gzigs ma mdzad pa/ bde mchog gi rgyun bshags pu ri pas mdzad pa dang*/ rdo rje phag mo'i mdor bsdus pa'i bstod pa/ glog skya lotstsha'i 'gyur/ rdo rje phag mo mkha' spyod ma dkar mo'i bstod pa/ ti pam ka ras mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la bstod pa/ ti pam ka ras mdzad pa khu ne lo tsha'i 'gyur/ phag mo shes rab gsal byed kyi bstod pa/ kong ka na'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ grub pa dpal gyi 'gyur/ zhing gi dbang phyug ma'i bstod pa/ shin tu dga' ba'i paṇḍi tas mdzad pa nag tsho'i 'gyur/ dpal bde mchog bsgrub thabs de kho na nyid kyi snying po bsgrub pa/

phyag na rdo rje mdzad pa so ma na tha'i 'gyur/ dpal bde mchog gi mngon par rtogs pa/ lo hi pas mdzad pa chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ de'i 'grel pa pradzña rakṣi tas mdzad pa/ lo hi pas mdzad pa'i bsgrub thabs rgyud ltar bkrol ba/ dhi pam ka ra shri badzra mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ dpal mngon par rtogs pa'i 'grel ba rab tu dga' ba'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i mngon par rtogs pa'i man ngag 'khrul pa spong ba/ mkhas pa chen po 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ 'khor lo ma dpe las mi gsal/ 'grel pa sdom pa 'byung ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ slob dpon de nyid kyis mdzad pa de'i tri ka khyad par gsal byed/ bi pu ta tsan tra'i 'gyur ma dpe las mi gsal/ chog ma dpe las yig 'bru mi gsal/ rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad pa chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i bsgrub thabs kyi man ngag dril bu pas mdzad pa blo gros grags kyi 'gyur/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i rim pa lnga pa/ dril bu pas mdzad pa blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ de'i rang 'grel 'gos lha btsas kyis 'gyur/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i bsgrub thabs nag po pas mdzad pa/ chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ ma dpe las mi gsal/ dang thig le'i rnal 'byor/ rgyas bstan bcu pa/ nag po pas mdzad pa/ chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ gsang ba chen po'i de kho na nyid rab btu gsal ba/ nag po pas mdzad pa 'gos kyis bsgyur zhing*/ ba ri lo tstshas zhus dag byas pa/ ma dpe las mi gsal/ nag po pas mdzad pa'i rim pa bzhi pa/ shākya ye shes kyi bsgyur ba la mar dos gtan la phab pa/ rim pa bzhi pa'i 'grel pa nag po pas mdzad pa/ 'bro shes rab grags kyi 'gyur nag po pas mdzad pa'i sgron ma bzhi zhes pa'i man ngag gi ṭikka gsang ba'i sgron ma/ shri dha ra nyid kyis brtsams shing gtan la phab pa/ sgron ma bzhi'i rab du gsal bar byed pa'i bka' 'grel/

rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa/ shrī dha ra'i 'gyur/ dpa' 'khor lo sdom pa'i bsgrub thabs bdud rtsi 'dzag pa/ slob dpon bka' thub zla bas mdzad pa/ bde mchog gi mngon par rtogs pa shes par byed pa/ byang chub rdo rjes mdzad pa/ dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/ (sha)pa la 'khor lo sdom pa'i bsgrub thabs/ rgyal ba bzang pos mdzad pa rin chen grags pa'i 'gyur/ rje btsun dpal he ru ka'i bsgrub thabs/ bram ze bhing kar ras mdzad pa/ bde mchog lha bcu gsum pa'i bsgrub thabs rin chen gtsug gi nor bu/ zla ba pas mdzad pa chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ bde mchog bcu gsum ma'i bsgrub thabs/ gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ dpal he ru ka'i bsgrub thabs/ rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ dpal bde mchog gi bsgrub thabs nyin mo mdzad kyis mdzad pa/ dge ba'i blo gros gyi 'gyur/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud las btus pa'i bsgrub thabs/ byang chub kyi sems kun tu gzigs pa'i phreng ba/ 'gos lha btsas kyis 'gyur/ yi ge bdun pa'i bsgrub thabs nag po pas mdzad pa shes rab brtsegs kyi 'gyur la chos kyi dbang phyug gis gtan la phab pa/ yi ge bdun pa'i bsgrub thabs gnyis su med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa mar pa'i 'gyur/ yi ge bdun pa'i bsgrub thabs rgyal bka' zla bas btus pa/ bde mchog phyag gnyis ma'i bsgrub thabs/ rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad pa chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur bde mchog lhan skyes bdag byin gyis brlab pa/ rgyal po in tra bo te 'bring pos mdzad pa rje mi nyag gi 'gyur/ bde mchog lhan skyes te lo pas mdzad pa/ dpal lhan cig skyes pa'i man ngag ri khrod pa chen po'i gsung*/ dpal lhan cig skyes pa bde ba'i mchog gi bdag byin gyis brlabs pa/ phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag rnams mi nyag gi 'gyur/

rang byin gyi brlabs pa'i man ngag a bhya ka ra gu pa tas mdzad pa chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/ rang byin gyis brlabs pa'i man ngag gi bsgrub thabs/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ku ma ra shris mdzad pa/ bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i bsgrub thabs lu hi pas mdzad pa/ de kho na'i snying po'i bsgrub thabs/ dad byed go chas mdzad pa blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ byang chub kyi sems bde ba chen po'i man ngag /dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur zhing*/ pho brang byang chub 'od kyis bcos pa/ dpal nag po chen po'i bsgrub thabs klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ de kho na nyid snying po'i bsgrub thabs/ slob dpon lu hi pas mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang pos bsgyur zhing chag lo tsha ba dgra bcom gyis zhus dag byas pa/ bde mchog 'khor lo dpa' bo gcig pa'i bsgrub thabs/ rin chen rdo rje mdzad pa ting nge 'dzin bzang po'i 'gyur/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i bsgrub thabs garba ri pas mdzad pa/ 'khor lo sdom pa dpa' bo gcig pa'i bsgrub thabs/ mo na ga shris mdzad pa/ pradzña dzña na girtis bsgyur ba la/ chos kyi dbang phyug gis bcos pa/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i dpa' bo gcig pa'i bsgrub thabs/ mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ dpal chen po'i bsgrub thabs/ ḍom bi he ru kas mdzad pa gnyis nag tsho'i 'gyur/ dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i thabs/ rin po che pad ma ra ga'i gter/ dza ya se nas mdzad pa/ rkang pa bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa'i bstod pa gnyis dharma yon tan gyi 'gyur/ gtor ma'i cho ga rin po che ad ma garba dza ya se nas mdzad pa/ maṇḍal gyi cho ga rin po che margad dza ya se nas mdzad pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga rin po che me shel rnams dza ya se na'i gsung la ye shes rdo rjes bsgyur ba/ rab du gnas pa'i cho ga'i rim pa nag po pas mdzad pa/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i rab du gnas pa'i cho ga gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa rma ban chos 'bar gyi 'gyur/

'khor lo sdom pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga thun mong ba/ su ma ti ghirtis mdzad pa/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i rim pa nag po pas mdzad pa/ bde mchog 'khor lo'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rig pa gzhon nus bsgyur ba/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga nyin mdzad rdo rjes mdzad pa/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po'i 'gyur/ ro sreg gi cho ga ta thā ga ta rakṣi tas mdzad pa/ phyir rol mchod pa'i cho ga rtag pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ gtor ma'i cho ga mdor bsdus rtag pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ lag pa'i mchod pa'i cho ga mdor bsdus rtag pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rigs ldan ma'i de kho na nyid nges pa u rgyan pas grub par mdzad pa ti pam ka ra'i 'gyur/ gzhon nu ma mchod pa'i cho ga stong nyid ting nge 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ bi pu ta tsan tra'i 'gyur/ bdud rtsi lnga'i ril bu bsgrub pa bi pu ta tsan tras mdzad pa/ de nyid kyis 'gyur/ thod pa mchod pa'i rim pa gtor ma'i mchod pa'i cho ga'i rim pa mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ rnal 'byor pa dang rnal 'byor pa'i rang 'byung gi longs spyod dur khrod kyi rtog pa bir ba pas mdzad pa/ pradzña shri dzña na kirtis mdzad pa'i 'gyur/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga ḍom bi he ru kas mdzad pa/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga bzang po byin pas mdzad pa kun na dga' rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ ḍom bi he ru kas thun mong ma yin pa'i don la gdams pa pradzña ghirti'i 'gyur/ las kyi phyag rgya rtag pa'i man ngag a mo gha badzra las byung ba 'gos lha btsas gyi 'gyur/ rjes chags kyi sbyor bas/ de kho na nyid la 'jug pa'i man ngag don yod rdo rjes mdzad pa/ dbang chog gi gdams ngag na ro pas mdzad pa/ sma ban chos 'bar gyi 'gyur/ dug lnga sbas pa'i lam mchog tu gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i snying po'i de kho na nyid bsgrub pa/

dza lan dha ri pas mdzad pa/ 'khor lo sdom pa lhan cig skyes pa de kho na nyid snang ba/ dpag med rdo rjes mdzad pa chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i gnyis su med pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i man ngag rnal 'byor gyi gtum mo/ dge ba'i mgon pos mdzad pa/ chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i snying po de kho na nyid bsdus pa ku su lu pas mdzad pa/ chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i de kho na nyid kyi man ngag ku su lu pas mdzad pa/ chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ lhan cig skyes pa'i de kho na nyid snang ba ku su lu pas mdzad pa chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ dpal he ru ka'i man ngag cho ga nyi shu pa rang byin gyis brlab pa/ ting nge 'dzin bzang pos mdzad pa/ ser tsa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ yum gyi skor la/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsgrubs thabs/ de kho na nyid ma dpe las mi gsal/ ting nge 'dzin bzang pos mdzad/ blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsgrub thabs dgongs pa bla na med pa/ u rgyan nas byung ba/ rma ban chos 'bar gyi 'gyur/ don thams cad 'grub pa'i bsgrub thabs/ a ba bhu ti pas mdzad pa/ blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ ye shes dbab pa zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor gyi cho ga stong nyid snying rje 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje phag mo dbu bcad ma'i bsgrub thabs lha mo dpal gyi blo gros mas mdzad pa/ blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ dbu bcad ma'i bsgrub thabs/ bir wa pas mdzad pa/ gsang ba'i sbyin sreg cho ga sangs rgyas byin gyis mdzad pa/ keng rus ta ra na'i bsgrub thabs/ bhya yi pas mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa gzhan la phan pa/ slob dpon ku ma ra bo dhis mdzad pa/ zhing gi dbang phyug ma'i mchod pa'i cho ga /shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ las dang po pa'i bsgom pa mdor bsdus pa dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsgrub thabs/

nā ro pa'i zhal gyi gdam ngag pradzña kir ti'i 'gyur rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsgrub thabs mngon par rtogs pa'i snye ma/ dā na shi la'i 'gyur/ rdo rje phag mo'i bsgrub thabs byang chub sems dpa' rgyal po seng ge'i gdan can khyab bdag sbas pas nges par sbyar ba/ pradzña girti'i 'gyur/ dpa' mo gcig ma'i rnal 'byor ma'i bsgrub pa'i thabs shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ rdo rje phag mo'i bsgrub thabs pradzña bha tras mdzad pa chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ u rgyan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gnas nas byung ba/ rdo rje phag mo'i bsgrub thabs/ rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad pa/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /shri u ma pa ti dyad thas mdzad pa chos rab kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsgrub thabs me tri pas mdzad pa dar ma tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sum cu so bdun gyi bsgrub thabs/ shri u ma pa ti dad tas mdzad pa chos rab kyi 'gyur/ shes rab snang ba'i bsgrub thabs/ kong kas byin gyis mdzad pa/ chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsgrub thabs/ dza lan dha ra pas mdzad pa/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsgrub thabs/ ti pam ka ra shri dzña nas mdzad pa rgya brtson 'grus seng ge'i 'gyur/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mo'i bsgrub thabs/ ri khrod dbang phyug gis bstan pa/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dkar mo'i bsgrub thabs/ in tra bo ti'i gzhung*/ bāe ro tsa na'i 'gyur/ phag mo shes rab gsal byed kyi dbang du bya ba'i bsgrub thabs/ kong ka dad tas mdzad pa zhang grub pa dpal gyi 'gyur/ rdo rje phag mo dkar mo'i bsgrub thabs/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sngags kyi de kho na nyid kyi byin gyis rlabs pa'i rim pa/ int+ra bo tis mdzad pa ye shes rdo rje'i 'gyur/ rdo rje phag mo'i rtag pa don thams cad grub pa/ sbyin sreg gi de kho na/

rnal 'byor ma'i bsgrub thabs lakṣi ka ras mdzad pa/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'grel pa rnal 'byor gsum gyi rjes su 'brengs pa/ ḍa ri kas mdzad pa dha na shi la'i 'gyur/ bya rog lags pa'i gtor chog /paṇa ḍi ta klu'i sbyin pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i snying po'i don bsdus pa bstan pa/ dha na shi la'i 'gyur/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i mchod chog /dha ri ka pas mdzad pa dha na shi la'i 'gyur/ rje btsun rnal 'byor ma'i mchod pa'i cho ga sā ba ri pas mdzad pa/ bai ro tsa na'i 'gyur/ mngon pa ba kur ma pa ti'i gdams pa/ mkha' spyod ma dmar mo'i bsgrub thabs/ mngon pa bas mdzad pa/ dpyal chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ rnal 'byor ma'i byin brlabs kyi cho ga mdor bsdus pa/ sha ba ri pas mdzad pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ slob ma rjes su bzung ba'i cho ga sha ba ri pas mdzad pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga sha ba ri pas mdzad pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ phag mo'i bsgrub thabs kyi cho ga don thams cad grub pa/ gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ rdo rje phag mo'i bsgrub thabs/ gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ mtshur ston dbang nge'i 'gyur/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mchod pa lags pa mdor bsdus pa mtshur gyi 'gyur/ slob ma rjes su bzung ba'i cho ga ba len tra ru tshes mdzad pa/ byang chub 'byung gnas kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsang ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga a bi dzu ka tas mdzad pa/ gsad pa'am las sbyar gi cho ga a bi dzu ka tas mdzad pa/ phyir bzlog gi 'khor lo'i phag mo'i bsrung 'khor/ drag po mngon spyod kyi las/ pra bstan pa/ gtor ma'i cho ga ye shes dbab pa'i cho ga ye shes 'pho ba'i rim pa a ba dhu ti pas mdzad pa/ lag pa'i mchod pa/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i mchod thabs/ de kho na nyid yang dag par grub pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa/

de kho na nyid bshad pa/ paṇḍi ta brtson 'grus bshes gnyen zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ de rnams ni rnal 'byor bla na med pa ma'i rgyud las/ 'khor lo bde mchog dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskor rim par phye ba'o// de nas kye'i rdo rje'i bskor la/ kye'i rdo rje yab yum dang*/ cha mthun pa sangs rgyas thod pa'i bskor las/ kye'i rdo rje dngos la/ (sa)pa la dpal kye'i rdo rje nges pa'i don gyi rgya cher bshad pa/ byang chub sems pa rdo rje snying pos mdzad pa/ le'u lnga pa yan chad shākya brtson 'grus kyi 'gyur/ gzhan rnams shes rab grags kyi 'gyur/ dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i bka' 'grel rdo rje'i tshig bsdus/ ka ma la dhe'us mdzad pa/ chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ kye'i rdo rje'i rgyud kyi bka' 'grel pad ma can/ mtsho skyes rdo rjes mdzad pa/ khu dngos grub kyi 'gyur/ kye'i rdo rje'i 'grel pa pad ma'i myug gus mdzad pa mtshur gyi 'gyur/ ku mu ta zhes bya ba'i bka' 'grel/ sbyangs bka' zla bas mdzad pa/ shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i bka' 'grel/ mu tig gi phreng ba/ shan ti bas mdzad pa 'gos lha btsas kyi 'gyur/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i bka' 'grel/ rin po che sbyor ba'i phreng ba/ nag po dam tshig rdo rjes mdzad pa 'gos lha btsas kyi 'gyur/ (ha)pa la dgyes pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus pa'i snying po rgya cher 'grel pa/ kha che chen pos mdzad pa dpyal chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur las/ grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis gtan la phab pa/ rdo rje'i tshig rgya cher 'grel pa snying po bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ nā ro 'grel chen nas phyung ba/ shākya shri bha tras mdzad pa chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ dpal nā ro pa'i thugs kyi nyi zla las/ gsung gi 'od zer 'phro ba zhes bya ba'i bka' 'grel dar ma seng ges bsgyur ba/ rgyud kyi rgyal po kye'i rdo rje'i 'grel pa kha sbyor dri ma med pa/

dhang ka dha shas mdzad pa/ blo brtan gyi bsgyur ba le'u dgu pa yan chad bzhugs/ (a)pa la de'i smad dang*/ dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i rnam bshad rnam pa ra 'grel pa zhes bya ba/ bha ba bha tras mdzad pa/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i bka' 'grel spyan 'byed sgron ma dharma kirtis mdzad pa rnams/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i bka' 'grel dran pa'i 'byung gnas/ nag po pas mdzad pa 'gos lha btsas kyi 'gyur/ bshad pa'i rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje drwa ba'i bka' 'grel de kho na nyid rgyas pa/ blo gros chen pos mdzad pa/ 'gos lha btsas kyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/ (ki)pa la rdo rje gur gyi bka' 'grel rgyal po int+ra bo tis mdzad pa/ rdo rje gur gyi bstod 'grel nag po pas mdzad pa/ shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur/ kha sbyor thig le'i rgyud kyis rgyal po'i rgya cher 'grel pa/ yang dag par blta ba'i dran pa'i snang ba/ rgyal po int+ra bo tis mdzad pa/ gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyi 'gyur/ dpal kha sbyor rgyud kyi rgya cher 'grel pa/ man ngag gi snye ma/ 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ stong phrag brgya pa/ sangs rgyas grags kyis bsgyur ba/ snye ma bco brgyad pa yan chad bzhugs/ (khi)pa la de smad/ rgyud phyi ma phyag rgya chen po thig le'i zab pa'i don rmad du byung ba/ phyi nang gsang ba rgya cher bshad pa/ slob dpon zab pa'i rdo rjes bshad pa g.yung drung snying po'i 'gyur/ dga' ba'i spyan zhes bya ba'i rgya cher 'grel pa/ shes rab dpal gsang bas mdzad pa rin chen rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ dpal kun tu kha sbyor las byung ba rgya cher bshad pa/ rin po che'i phreng ba dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgyud phyi ma ye shes thig le'i bka' 'grel gsang ba'i de kho na nyid/ dzña na pa ra ma yis mdzad pa/ byang chub 'byung gnas kyi 'gyur/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa/ kye'i rdo rje yang dag par sbyor ba dang*/

rdo rje mkha' 'gro las rtsa'i 'khor lo'i skabs shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur/ dur khrod kyi bshad pa 'gos lha btsas kyi 'gyur/ dur khrod brgyad bshad pa shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur/ yang dur khrod brgyad bshad pa shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur/ badha nges par bzung ba'i rim pa bshad pa/ shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje'i klu nges par bshad pa/ sgron ma can gyi sdes mdzad pa/ shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur/ klu'i de kho na nyid pad mas mdzad pa/ shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur/ dgongs pa'i skad kyi 'grel pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ shes rab grags kyi 'gyur/ slongs mo 'grel pa ḍom bi pas mdzad pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ dpal de kho na nyid kyi sgron ma'i 'grel pa/ rin chen phreng ba ma ha su kha ta badzra mdzad pa byang chub 'byung gnas kyi 'gyur/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum gsal bar byed pa/ gnyan na shrīs mdzad cing de nyid kyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/ (gi)pa la kye'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi las kyi rim pa'i cho ga mtsho skyes rdo rjes mdzad pa/ shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga yongs su bzung ba mi thub zla bas mdzad pa/ tshul khrims shes rab kyi 'gyur/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i gzhung 'grel gyi cho ga /nag po pas mdzad pa/ he ru ka 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /nyin mo'i 'byung gnas zla bas mdzad pa/ dbang rin chen snang ba zhes bya ba/ shes rab gsang bas mdzad pa/ kam ston chos yes dang*/ phyug 'tshams dbang phyug rgya mtsho'i 'gyur/ dbang rin chen 'phreng ba'i man ngag shes rab gsang bas mdzad pa de nyid kyi 'gyur/ dbang gi rim pa mdor bsdus pa/ shes rab gsang bas mdzad pa/ sna tshogs dga' ba'i pad ma'i dbang gi me tog /shes rab gsang bas mdzad pa rin chen rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur gsang ba'i dbang gi rab du byed pa/ sdi na pas mdzad pa/ 'gos lha bcas kyis 'gyur/

dgyes pa rdo rje'i dbang gtan la dbab pa/ dgra las rgyal bas mdzad pa/ zla ba 'od zer gyi 'gyur/ dpal dga' ba'i me tog gi 'phreng ba/ int+ra bodhis mdzad pa/ dbang bskur ba'i cho ga pradzña shris mdzad pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid/ gsang ba'i man ngag gi ming gis rab tu dbye ba si na pas mdzad pa/ dbang chen po'i rim pa gsum pa/ 'od srungs gzhon nus mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ bstod pa nyi shu pa slob dpon mtsho skyes rdo rjes mdzad pa/ shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i bstod pa slob dpon rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa/ byang chub shes rab kyi 'gyur/ bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i bstod pa/ 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa/ ku ru ku le'i bstod pa/ ḍoṃ bi he ru kas mdzad pa/ de nyid snang ba zhes bya ba/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i bsgrub thabs/ so ma na thas mdzad pa 'jig rten mgon po'i 'gyur/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i bsgrub thabs mtsho skyes kyis mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa rim pa gnyis pa/ rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad pa/ shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i bsgrub thabs yan lag drug pa/ mi thub zla bas mdzad pa/ kye'i rdo rje'i bsgrub thabs gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ 'khrul pa spong ba zhes bya ba/ kye'i rdo rje'i bsgrub thabs/ shan ti bas mdzad pa/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i bsgrub thabs rin po che'i sgron me mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ dar ma blo gros kyi 'gyur/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i bsgrub thabs de kho na nyid gsal bar byed pa/ nag po pa'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ dpa' bo gcig pa dpal he ru ka'i bsgrub thabs/ ḍoṃ bi he ru kas mdzad pa/ dgyes pa rdo rje dpa' bo gcig pa'i bsgrub thabs/ nag po pas mdzad pa 'gos lha btsas kyi 'gyur/ he ru ka zhal gcig pa'i bsgrub thabs/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa chos 'bar gyi 'gyur/ rtsed ba'i rdo rje phyag bcu drug pa'i bsgrub thabs/

kriṣṇa pas mdzad pa/ dpa' bo gcig pa he ru ka phyag bcu drug pa'i bsgrub thabs/ he badzra'i bsgrub thabs/ bde ba'i rdo rjes mdzad pa dharma tsan tra'i 'gyur/ dgyes pa rdo rje zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i bsgrub thabs/ sa ha dza bi la pa rma ban chos 'bar gyi 'gyur bdud rtsi 'od kyi bsgrub thabs/ ḍoṃ bi he ru kas mdzad pa/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i bsgrub thabs de kho na nyid bzhi'i rim pa/ ka ma las mdzad pa/ dar ma blo gros kyi 'gyur/ gsung bsdus pa dgyes pa rdo rje'i bsgrub thabs/ shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ kye'i rdo rje phyag gnyis pa'i bsgrub thabs/ a la la badzras mdzad pa/ kye'i rdo rje'i phyag drug pa'i bsgrub thabs/ ra ta shris mdzad pa chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ kye'i rdo rje'i bsgrub thabs byang chub snying pos mdzad pa/ lha btsan po mu ne ra dza'i 'gyur/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i bsgrub thabs/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad pa shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur/ kye'i rdo rje'i dran pa gcig pa garba ri pas mdzad pa shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur/ dgyes pa rdo rje lhan cig skyes pa bsgrub pa'i thabs/ shrī a nan tas mdzad pa dang*/ kye'i rdo rje lha dgu'i mngon par rtog pa he ru ka mnyes par bya ba'i cho ga slob dpon chen po 'jam dpal ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ rong zom chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur gnyis/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i maṇḍal gyi cho ga mtsho skyes kyis mdzad pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga mtsho skyes kyis mdzad pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga mdor bsdus pa garba ri pa mdzad pa/ shes rab skyabs kyi 'gyur/ dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i rab gnas kyi cho ga slob dpon nag po pas mdzad pa/ 'gos lha btsas kyi 'gyur/ sbyin sreg gsang ba'i man ngag rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa/ gtum po'i man ngag sbyin sreg gi cho ga dpal gyi zhabs kyi bshad pa/ ro sreg pa'i cho ga nag po pas mdzad pa/ 'gos lha btsas kyi 'gyur/

dgyes pa rdo rje'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga nag po pas mdzad pa 'gos lha btsas kyi 'gyur/ rab gnas kyi cho ga'i tshul nag po pas mdzad pa/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa'i rim pa/ nag po pas mdzad pa 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga mi thub zla bas mdzad pa shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur/ gtor ma'i de kho na nyid bsdus pa/ ḍaṃ ka pas mdzad pa/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i gtor ma'i rim pa/ a la la badzras mdzad pa zla ba 'od zer gyi 'gyur/ khro bo bcu'i rig ma'i cho ga 'dze ta ris mdzad pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ gtor ma'i las kyi rim pa/ rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa/ dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i bstod pa/ mtsho skyes kyis mdzad pa/ shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur/ khrus chog chen po/ gshin gyi cho ga nag po pas mdzad pa/ tshogs 'khor dam tshig lnga pa/ slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa/ dharma girti'i 'gyur/ yum gyi skor la/ bdag med ma'i bsgrub thabs/ kri ṣṇa paṇḍi tas mdzad pa/ bdag med ma'i bsgrub thabs mi thub zla bas mdzad pa shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur/ bdag med ma'i bsgrub thabs rgyas par bstan pa/ slob dpon dkon mchog 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa/ bdag med ma'i rab tu gnas pa/ gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ mkha' 'gro lnga'i bsgrub thabs/ mi thub zla bas mdzad pa shes grags kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje gur gyi dkyil 'khor gyi bsdus pa zhes bya ba'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i bsgrub thabs/ lha'i brtul zhugs kyis mdzad pa/ dpal mo gcig pa'i bsgrub thabs/ sgra gcan 'dzin gyis mdzad pa shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur/ 'phags ma rdo rje sgrol ma'i bsgrub thabs rdo rje gur las byung ba/ sna tshogs dmar po zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ dha na shi la'i 'gyur/ dgyes pa rdo rje las byung pa'i ku ru ku le'i bsgrub thabs lhan skyes sgeg pas mdzad pa dha na shi la'i 'gyur/ dgyes pa rdo rje las byung pa'i gung bu dgugs pa/

rkang pa dgu pa sprul gyi dug sel ba/ shes rab spel ba dbang du bsdu pa ste ku ru ku le'i man ngag chen po lnga zhi ba mtshos mdzad pa dha na shi la'i 'gyur/ dur khrod brgyad kyi dbus na bzhugs pa ku ru ku le'i bsgrub thabs/ rdo rje gur gyi man ngag de nyid bcu pa/ dri med grags pas mdzad pa mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyi 'gyur/ gdung sregs pa'i cho ga dpal gyi snying po'i 'gyur/ ngan song thams cad sbyong ba cho ga rim pa nā ro pas mdzad pa/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ mchod rten gyi cho ga nag po zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ de nyid bcu pa mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ dge ba'i blo gros kyis 'gyur/ bdag med ma'i man ngag /stong pa'i ting nge 'dzin rdo rjes mdzad pa/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/ ngi pa la kye'i rdo rje'i bya ba'i rim pa'i lam rin chen 'bar ba pradzña in tra ru rtsis mdzad pa shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur/ de kho na nyid bzhi pa'i man ngag gsang ba'i sgron ma/ te lo pas mdzad pa rad na shri'i 'gyur thig le chen po'i rim pa rdo rje sgeg pas mdzad pa/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba la yang dag par sbyor ba/ shan ti bas mdzad pa/ bde ba chen po bdud rtsi'i 'od ye shes rin po ches mdzad pa/ byang sems thigs pa'i man ngag las kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa/ man ngag rim pa gsum pa/ ḍoṃ bi he ru kas mdzad pa/ rim pa lnga pa shes rab gsang bas mdzad pa/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba la yang dag par sbyor ba/ shan ti bas mdzad pa ting nge 'dzin bzang po'i 'gyur/ lhan cig skyes pa'i rnal 'byor dam pa/ rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa/ ku ma ra kla shu'i 'gyur/ de'i 'grel pa snying po rab tu gsal bar byed pa/ bram ze tha ka nas mdzad pa/ man tra kla shu'i 'gyur/ kye'i rdo rje mar me'i rtse mo lta bu'i man ngag mtsho skyes rdo rjes mdzad pa shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur/

ye shes 'byung ba'i man ngag ga ya da ras mdzad pa shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur kye'i rdo rje bung ba lta bu'i bsgrub thabs/ rad na tsan tras mdzad pa/ rin chen thigs pa shes rab gsang bas mdzad pa/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i bsgrub thabs/ shes rab gsang bas mdzad pa/ yan lag brgyad pa'i rim pa/ le'u dgu pa shes rab gsang bas mdzad pa/ de kho na nyid bdud rtsi'i man ngag inta bo dhis mdzad pa/ rin chen char yang zhes bya ba'i bsgrub thabs/ shes rab gsang bas mdzad pa/ go bar byed pa'i snying po brgya pa'i ming snang ba mtha' yas rdo rjes mdzad pa/ 'dod pa'i bstan chos gzugs bzang gis mdzad pa/ nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ rang bzhin dga' ba'i sgron ma zhes bya ba'i bka' 'grel/ rdo rje gsang bas mdzad pa/ pradzña gu pa ta'i 'gyur/ rin po che'i snye ma zhes bya ba'i rgya cher 'grel pa/ shri gu pa tas mdzad pa de nyid kyi 'gyur/ de kho na nyid gsal bar mdzad pa/ kam pa la'i yum gyis mdzad pa/ kye'i rdo rje'i bkra shis ḍoṃ bi he ru kas mdzad pa/ de dag ni dpal kye'i rdo rje'i rtsa ba'i rgyud rtag pa gnyis pa bshad pa'i rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa'i bskor rim par phye ba'o// de nas dpal kye'i rdo rje dang cha mthun pa la/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgya cher 'grel 'jigs pa med pa'i gzhung 'grel/ a bhya ka ra gu pa tas mdzad pa/ spang blo gros brtan pa'i 'gyur/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i bka' 'grel ye shes ldan pa sa ra ha pas mdzad pa/ zla ba 'od zer gyi 'gyur/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rim pa gsal ba/ sa ra ha pas mdzad pa la zla ba 'od zer gyi 'gyur/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i bsgrub thabs/ lha nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ sa ra ha pas mdzad pa zla ba 'od zer gyi 'gyur/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma/ sa ra ha pas mdzad pa zla ba 'od zer gyi 'gyur/ de dag ni ma bla na med pa'i rgyud/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i bskor rim par phye ba'o// de nas gdan bzhi'i bskor la/

rgyud kyi rgyal po gdan bzhi pa'i 'grel pa dran pa'i rgyun/ bha ba bha tras mdzad pa 'gos lha btsas kyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/ (ci)pa la dpal 'phags pa gdan bzhi'i rnam par bshad pa sbyor ba'i gdan yan chad/ dge ba'i go chas mdzad cing*/ gsang ba'i gdan gyi 'grel pa smri tis mdzad pa de nyid kyi 'gyur/ gdan bzhi'i dkyil chog snying po mdor bsags/ arya de bas mdzad pa/ 'gos lha btsas kyi 'gyur/ gdan bzhi'i bsgrub thabs arya de bas mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i bsgrub thabs/ rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes mdzad pa/ ye shes dbang phyug ma'i bsgrub thabs/ 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa smri ta'i 'gyur/ shing gcig pa'i rgya cher bshad pa/ 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa/ mchan khung sbyor ba 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rdo rje dril thabs kyi mchod pa'i cho ga rim pa/ 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa/ 'chi ba slu ba'i man ngag slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ yang dag ye shes snang ba zhes bya ba'i bsgrub thabs le'u bzhi pa/ chu'i sbyin sreg slob dpon bha ba bha tras mdzad pa/ tshul khrims gzhon nu'i 'gyur/ de kho na nyid drug pa rnam par bzhag pa/ smri tis mdzad pa de nyid kyi 'gyur rnams ni gdan bzhi'i bskor ro// de dang cha mthun pa rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud kyi bshad pa smri tis mdzad pa/ rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud kyi rgyal po rgya cher 'grel pa/ bdud rtsi 'dzag pa bha nos mdzad pa/ la chings yon tan 'bar dang klog skya shes rab brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ dpal gdan bzhi pa dang rdo rje bdud rtsi'i bskor rim par phye ba'o// ma ha ma ya'i bskor la/ dpal sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i 'grel pa yon tan ldan pa/ shan ti bas mdzad pa 'gos lha btsas kyi 'gyur sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rgyud kyi 'grel ba dran pa nag po/ dam tshig rdo rjes mdzad pa 'gos lha btsas kyi 'gyur/

sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rgyud kyi bka' 'grel rgyan pas mdzad pa 'gos lha btsas kyi 'gyur/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rgyud kyi bka' 'grel sgyu ma can/ dhur dzdza ya tsan tras mdzad pa/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i dkyil 'khor kyi cho ga /ku ku ri pas mdzad pa 'gos lha btsas kyi 'gyur/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rim pa gsal ba/ nag po spyod pa bas mdzad pa tshul khrims gzhon nu'i 'gyur/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i dkyil 'khor kyi cho ga nag po pas mdzad pa rnams bzhugs/ chipa la sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bla ma'i zhal snga'i man ngag 'dul ba byin gyis mdzad pa/ chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i zhal gzigs kyi bstod pa/ slob dpon ku ku ra dzas mdzad pa/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'brengs pa he ru ka'i bsgrub thabs/ shin tu spros pa med pa'i bsgrub thabs/ slob dpon ku ku ri pas mdzad pa/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i bsgrub thabs/ shan ti bas mdzad pa shes rab ye shes kyi 'gyur/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i bsgrub thabs/ sku mes rdo rjes mdzad pa/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i bsgrub thabs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i sbyin sreg dang bcas pa/ de kho na nyid kyi man ngag rtsa 'grel/ 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ de kho na nyid kyi tshig le'ur byas pa/ su dza dza ya shri mdzad pa nag tsho shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i bsgrub thabs/ u rgyan nas byon pa/ shākya brtson 'grus kyi 'gyur sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i bsgrub thabs/ rin chen bzang po rdo rjes mdzad pa 'phags pa shes rab kyi 'gyur/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i bsgrub thabs nag po pas mdzad pa/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rdzogs rim/ chos kyi zhabs kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa 'gos kyi 'gyur/ byang chub kyi sems thigs pa'i man ngag

las kyi zhabs kyi mdzad pa/ he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i bsgrub thabs/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i bsgrub thabs spyi'i cho spyod nag po pas mdzad pa/ ro sreg pa'i cho ga /rje btsun dpal he ru ka 'khor dang bcas pa la bstod pa/ las dang po pa'i bya ba 'gos lha btsas kyi 'gyur/ bdun tshigs kyi cho ga nag po pas mdzad pa/ tsha tsha gdab pa'i man ngag sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i gtor ma'i cho ga ku ku ri pas mdzad pa rnams/ ma ha ma ya'i skor rim par phye ba'o// de nas sgyu ma bde mchog la/ sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba'i bka' 'grel/ rab tu zhi ba'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor sgyu ma bde mchog gi rgyud kyi don rnam par bshad pa/ brgya byin sdong pos mdzad pa lha rin po che'i 'gyur sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi bka' 'grel/ int+ra bo tis mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde mchog de kho na'i rtog pa thams cad bsdus pa zhes bya ba rnam par bshad pa/ shes rab snang ba zhes bya ba slob dpon kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa/ smri ti dzña na kirti'i 'gyur/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi dkyil 'khor kyi cho ga sems can thams cad kyi bde ba bskyed pa zhes bya ba/ kha che rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa/ ye shes rdo rje dang*/ gnyan ban bsod sdes bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/ (ji)pa la sgyu ma bde mchog gi 'grel pa mnyam sbyor gyi rgyan/ rab dga'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i/ hūm̐ mdzad rdo rjes mdzad pa lha rin po che'i 'gyur// sangs rgyas mnyam par sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ku ku ra dzas mdzad pa dran pa nam mkha' bsgyur ba las/ lha rin po ches bcos pa/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rjes su 'jug pa la 'jug pa'i cho ga lnga pa/ ku ku ra dzas mdzad pa sma rin chen mchog gi 'gyur/

bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa rdo rje 'dzin gyi dbyangs dang*/ de'i 'grel pa/ zhi ba mtshos mdzad pa dpal rtsegs kyi 'gyur/ dpal khrag 'thung chen po'i bsgrub thabs yang dag bsgrub pa hūṃ ka ras mdzad pa nam mkha'i snying po'i 'gyur/ dpal he ru ka'i bsgrub thabs/ ra dza ha tis mdzad pa/ dpal he ru ka'i bsgrub thabs/ hūṃ mdzad rdo rjes mdzad pa lha rin po che'i 'gyur/ yan lag bzhi yi don snang bar byed pa/ hūṃ mdzad grags kyis mdzad pa/ sma rin mchog gi 'gyur/ rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang don rnam par bkod pa/ ku ku ra dzas mdzad pa/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi gsang don rnam par bkod pa/ ku ku ra dzas mdzad pa/ he ru ka'i gsang don rnam par bkod pa/ ku ku ra dzas mdzad pa/ pad ma gar dbang gis don rnam par bkod pa/ ku ku ra dzas mdzad pa/ rin chen nyi ma'i gsang don rnam par bkod pa/ ku ku ra dzas mdzad pa/ rta mchog rol pa'i gsang don rnam par bkod pa/ ku ku ra dzas mdzad pa rnams lha rin po che'i 'gyur/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i rjes su dran pa'i cho ga /ra dza ha tis mdzad pa/ dpal he ru ka'i rjes su dran pa'i cho ga /ra dza ha tis mdzad pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgrub thabs ra dza ha tis mdzad pa/ dpal he ru ka'i bsgrub thabs/ ra dza ha tis mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i tshogs kyi cho ga itna bo tis mdzad pa/ nam mkha' bsgyur ba las lha rin po che bcos pa/ de rnams ni yang dag sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi bskor rim par phye ba'o// de nas rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ de nyid bsdus pa'i bshad rgyud phran dang bcas pa dang*/ 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i bskor las 'dir/ de nyid bsdus pa'i 'grel pa/ slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa kos sa la'i rgyan/ rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba'i stod/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i 'grel pa yan chad bzhugs/ (nyi)pa la de'i 'jug yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/

slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa'i rgyud la 'jug pa'i 'grel pa 'jam go chas bsgyur ba'i stod rnams bzhugs/ (ti)dang*/ (thi)la de'i smad cung zad dang de nyid bsdus pa'i 'grel pa stong phrag bco brgyad pa/ de nyid snang ba/ slob dpon kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa/ stod 'grel rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ bar dang smad gnyis zangs dkar gyi 'gyur ba tshang bar bzhugs/ (di)dang*/ (ni)la dpal mchog sher dum gyi 'grel pa chung ba dang*/ dpal mchog dang po'i 'grel chen stong phrag nyi shu pa/ kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba las/ ma tshang ba'i hor ging rnams/ lha pho brang zhi ba 'od kyis bsgyur nas bsabs pa yongs su rdzogs par bzhugs/ (pi)pa la rgyud kyi don la 'jug pa'i 'grel bshad ji snyed 'gyur ba/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i 'grel pa/ mu ti ko shas mdzad pa/ gzi brjid rgyal po'i rtag pa phyi ma dang bcas pa'i bshad pa gsal ba'i sgron ma slob dpon kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa/ khyung po chos brtson gyi 'gyur/ gzi brjid rgyal po'i rtag pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba'i 'grel pa/ dge slong dbang phyug rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ ngan song yongs su sbyong ba'i 'grel pa mdzes pa'i rgyan drug stong bzhi bcu pa rdo rje go cha'i slob ma kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa'i stod rnams bzhugs/ (phi)pa la de'i smad dang*/ ngan song sbyong ba gzi brjid rgyal po'i cho ga /zhib mo'i 'grel pa'i snying po rnam par bshad pa/ ka ma de nus mdzad pa chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ dpal gsang ba'i bshad sbyar gsang ba'i sgron ma/ shan ti bas mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga rdo rje 'byung ba/ kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur rdo rje 'byung ba'i don bsdus pa/ mu ni ta tras mdzad pa chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/

rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyis rnam par bzhag pa/ mu ti ka ko shas mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa/ khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/ (bi)pa la rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgrub thabs/ kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje sems dpa' 'byung ba zhes bya ba/ kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa/ dpal ldan rgya che ba zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ngan song yongs su sbyong ba'i cho ga'i bya ba mdor bsdus pa/ a nan ta ba ra hi tas mdzad pa/ tha ma'i cho ga rin po che bde bar gshegs pa'i gnas la 'god pa'i ting nge 'dzin bzang pos mdzad pa pradzña girti'i 'gyur/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor bsdus pa'i don bsdus pa ku ma ra kla shu'i 'gyur/ ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gtsug gtor dgu pa/ slob dpon kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gtsug gtor dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ maṇa ñdzu shri warma dang*/ brag ka mu ti 'gyur/ rdo rje chos kyi rnal 'byor gcig pa bsgom pa'i thabs can dbye ba'i cho ga /kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa/ rab 'byor skyangs kyis mdzad pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ kun du bzang po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rdo rje gtsug gtor gyi rgyud las/ ngan song sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dharma girtis mdzad pa/ rig pa'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ ngan song sbyong ba'i shi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i las kyi rim pa kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ ngan song sbyong ba'i thabs sbyin sreg gi dkyil chog

skal bzang dga' bas mdzad pa/ g.yung drung 'od kyi 'gyur/ dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud de nyid bsdus pa bshad pa'i rgyud rnams dang bcas pa rim par phye ba'o// gzhan yang dag par mtshan yang dag par brjod pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud du bkral ba/ sngags don rnam gzigs nyis stong lnga brgya pa dpal sna tshogs gzugs kyis mdzad pa/ smri tis bsgyur ba las phyis klog skya shes rab brtsegs kyis bcos pa/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'grel chung rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa/ 'jam dpal grags pas mdzad pa rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba'i stod yan chad bzhugs/ (mi)pa la de'i smad dang*/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i bshad pa'i 'bum le'u bcu bzhi pa de nyid kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i man ngag gi 'grel pa/ slob dpon gzhon nu grags pas mdzad pa shes rab bla ma'i 'gyur/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i mtshan don gsal ba'i sgron ma bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa dzña na ku ma ra'i 'gyur/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'grel pa/ tsant+ra go mis mdzad pa shes rab brtson 'grus kyi 'gyur/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'grel pa/ zla ba bzang po grags pa'i dpal gyis mdzad pa 'phags pa shes rab kyi 'gyur/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i don gsal bar byed pa/ dga' rab rdo rjes mdzad pa/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i snying po mngon par rtogs pa/ gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa pradzña shrī ghirti'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi 'grel pa bsdus pa'i gsal ba/ a ba dhu ti pas mdzad pa chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ mtshan brjod nye bar bsdus pa'i rtog ge /gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ me tri ba'i gdam ngag nye bar bsdus pa/ zab cing rgya che ba'i 'grel ba/ dril bu pas mdzad pa blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (tsi)pa la mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'grel pa mtshan don gsal bar byed pa/

slob dpon gnyis med sbas pas mdzad pa/ chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa ratna a ka ra gu pa tas mdzad pa 'brog jo sras kyi 'gyur/ mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa sho lo ka stong drug brgya lnga bcu pa/ ḍoṃ bi he ru kas mdzad pa dge tshul khyung grags kyi 'gyur/ mtshan brjod yon tan dang sngags dang gnyis su med par 'chad pa/ tshul gsum pa'i sgron me/ mtshan brjod kyi 'grel bsgrub thabs nam mkha' dri ma med pa 'jam dpal grags pas mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga yon tan 'byung gnas dpal ldan byang chub mchog gi skal ba dang ldan pas mdzad pa/ smri ti'i 'gyur la 'phags pa mchog gis gtan la phab pa/ thig gdab pa'i rim pa smri tis mdzad pa/ rab du gnas pa'i cho ga smra tis mdzad pa/ rang 'gyur/ a ba dhu ti pa dang*/ gnyis med rdo rje la sogs pa dang*/ rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad pa rnams/ rnal 'byor bla med du bkral yang*/ mtshan brjod kyi bzlas drangs nas 'dir bsgrigs so// bcom ldan 'das kyi 'jam dpal rnon po la bstod pa gsungs pa/ 'jam dpal gyi don dam pa'i bstod pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal gyi snying rje la bstod pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal gyi dbyangs la bstod pa yon tan mtha' yas pa'i 'khor lo/ phyogs kyi glang pos mdzad pa/ gur gum gzhon nu'i bstod pa seng ge mi g.yo bas mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ 'jam dpal gyi bstod pa byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ tsan tra go mis mdzad pa chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ 'jam ye shes yon tan bzang po'i bstod pa/ rdo rje mtshon tshas mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'jam dbyangs la bstod pa gser gyi phreng ba/ ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig pa la bstod pa ma tis mdzad pa/ 'jam dbyangs la bstod pa 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyis mdzad pa gzhon nu 'bar gyi 'gyur/

'jam dbyangs la smre sngags dang bcas bstod pa/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ gsung gi dbang phyug gi bstod pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ 'jam dpal khye'u bcu gcig gis bstod pa/ bu mo brgyad kyis bstod pa/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la bstod pa/ so ma shris mdzad pa gzhon nu 'od kyi 'gyur/ ngag gi dbang phyug gtso 'khor lnga pa'i bstod pa/ thig le bum pas mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal gyi khyad par gyi bstod pa/ a nan tra shri mi tras mdzad pa/ chos kyis shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 'jam dbyangs la bstod pa/ tsan tra go mis mdzad pa/ gnyan chung dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i bsgrub thabs gsang ldan byang chub mchog gis mdzad pa smri ti'i 'gyur/ de'i 'grel pa ye shes gsal ba smri ti'i 'gyur/ gsang ba'i bka' 'grel bshad pa don bsdus sgron ma klog skya'i 'gyur/ mtshan brjod klog pa'i sgom khog byang chub mchog gis mdzad pa/ mtshan brjod kyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga byang chub mchog kyis mdzad pa smri ti'i 'gyur/ 'jam dpal gyi bsgrub thabs dge bsnyen ma snyan grags dge bas mdzad pa 'jam dpal rin po che'i bsgrub thabs/ dge bsnyen ma snyan grags byin mas mdzad pa smri ti'i 'gyur/ ye shes sems dpa'i bsgrub thabs/ a ba dhu ti pas mdzad pa/ ye shes sems dpa'i bsgrub thabs dharma shri mi tras mdzad pa/ chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i bsgrub thabs/ a ba dhu ti pas mdzad pa chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'jam dpal gyi dkyil mchog ye shes gsal ba/ gnyis med sbas pas mdzad pa chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ mchod rten gyi bsgrub pa'i cho ga mdor bsdus pa/ gtor ma'i cho ga rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa'i cho gas 'jam dpal bsgrub pa'i thabs/ so ma shris mdzad pa gzhon nu 'od kyi 'gyur/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i bsgrub thabs/
