so ma shris mdzad pa gzhon nu 'od kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (tshi)pa la mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga so ma shris mdzad pa gzhon nu 'od kyi 'gyur/ 'jam dpal gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga yid bzhin nor bu zla bzang grags pas mdzad pa tshul khrims gzhon nu'i 'gyur/ mtshan brjod kyi dkyil 'khor cho ga shan ti garbas mdzad pa smri ti'i 'gyur/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i cho ga mdo dang sres pa// mtshan brjod dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dpal gyi cho ga zhes kun la sbyar ba byang sems rdo rje'i dbugs dbyung rnam snang dbugs dbyung ba'i cho ga 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ mi bskyod pa dbugs dbyung ba'i cho ga 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ snang ba mtha' yas dbyugs dbyung ba'i cho ga 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rin chen 'byung ldan dbugs dbyung ba'i cho ga 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ don yod grub pa dbyugs dbyung ba'i cho ga 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal gyi ro sreg gi cho ga 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ bdun tshigs kyi cho ga 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyi 'gyur/ tsha tsha'i cho ga 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ spyan dbye ba'i cho ga 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ ngan sngags kyi cho ga 'khor lo 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ bstod pa'i rim pa rnams chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'jam dpal gyi bsgrub thabs/ khrus kyi cho ga /chu sbyin/ mtshan brjod 'don pa'i man ngag maṇḍal gyi cho ga skor ba bya ba'i thabs/ tshogs gsog gi cho ga zas kyi rnal 'byor/

'byung po'i gtor ma/ tsha tsha'i cho ga bsngo ba/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa/ 'khor ba las yid nges par 'byung ba/ byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas la lta ba/ dbang po rab kyis de kho na nyid bsgom pa/ dbang po 'bring gis rten 'brel bcu gnyis bsgom pa/ dbang po tha mas rjes su dran pa drug bsgom pa/ nam gyi cha smad la mnyam par bzhag pa'i man ngag rnams/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ mtshan brjod klog pa'i man ngag kha che paṇa tri ta shākya shri bha tras mdzad pa/ mtshan brjod kyi cho ga yi ge brgya pa'i cho ga /slob dpon pad mas mdzad pa/ gsang ldan gyi pan dhar tha smri tis mdzad pa/ zha rgya gar rtsegs kyi 'gyur/ 'jam dpal gyi spyod lam gyi cho ga a shra ka shris mdzad pa chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje bum pa'i cho ga mya ngan med pa'i dpal gyis mdzad pa/ chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga mdor byas pa/ mya ngan med pa'i dpal gyis mdzad pa/ de rnams rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi bskor rnams rim par phye ba'o// de nas spyod pa'i rgyud la/ rnam snang mngon byang dang*/ rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba gnyis las/ rnam snang mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud kyi rgya cher 'grel pa/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad phyin ci ma log par bshad pa/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud kyi bsdus don nyis stong sum brgya pa/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa'i/ ska ba dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba'i stod bzhugs/ (dzi)pa la de'i smad dang*/ thugs rje 'byung ba'i bsgom pa dang*/ zlas pa'i cho ga /ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgya cher 'grel pas/ slob dpon kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i bka' 'grel/

rab du zhi ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mdzad pa/ de dag gis ni spyod pa'i rgyud kyi bskor rim par phye ba'o// de nas bya ba'i rgyud la spyi dang bye brag gnyis las/ spyi'i rgyud la 'phags pa dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i rgyud kyi bsdus don sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ de'i bsdus don brjod byang*/ dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa/ bsam gtan phyi ma rim par phye ba rgya cher bshad pa/ sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ chos spyod mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa gzi brjid snang ba/ klu'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa khyung grags kyi 'gyur/ chos spyod kyi mngon rtogs kyi rgyud las phyung ba'i man ngag bdud rtsi'i 'khor lo/ byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes mdzad pa rnams bzhugs/ (wi)pa la 'jam dpal gsang rgyud kyi 'grel pa rin po che'i phreng ba/ ngag gi dbang phyug gzhon nu pas mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal gsang rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /don yod zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i gsang ba'i rgyud rgya cher bshad pa ji snyed pa rnams bzhugs/ bye brag la rigs gsum so so dang*/ sgrol ma/ gtsug gtor/ bsrung ba lnga la sogs pa rnams las/ dpal phyag na rdo rje'i bskor la/ dza ba ri'i bskor dang*/ mdo lugs bha ba ma dang*/ 'gro bzang*/ gtum po rnam 'joms/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi bstod pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la bstod pa/ ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la bstod pa/ ti pam ka ra shrī dzña nas mdzad pa/ brtson 'grus seng ge'i 'gyur/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la mtshan nyid bsdus pa'i sgo nas bstod pa/ birya tsan tras bstod pa/ phyag na rdo rje'i bstod pa thung ngu/ 'khor lo chen po'i lha tshogs la bstod pa/ dza ba ri pas mdzad pa chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la bstod pa/

bram ze ma ṇi badzras mdzad pa rab zhi bshes gnyen gyi 'gyur/ phyag na rdo rje drag po gsum 'dul rgyud kyi 'grel pa bdud rtsi myu gu/ dza ba ri pas mdzad pa/ phyag na rdo rje'i bsgrub thabs 'khor lo chen po/ dza ba ri pas mdzad pa chos bzang gi 'gyur/ phyag na rdo rje'i bsgrub thabs bsdus pa/ dza ba ri pas mdzad pa chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi bsgrub thabs bdud rtsi thigs pa/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i bsrung ba/ klu rigs bzhi'i bsgrub thabs dza ba ri pas mdzad pa/ klu rigs bzhi mnan pa'i cho ga dza ba ri pas mdzad pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga dza ba ri pas mdzad pa/ sbyin sreg mdor bsdus pa'i cho ga dza ba ri pas mdzad pa/ gnod sbyin gyi sde sbyong zhing sel ba'i bsgrub thabs/ dza ba ri pas mdzad pa/ yi dwags dang*/ sha za dang*/ srul po rnams rnam par sbyong zhing*/ sel ba'i bsgrub thabs/ klu khro bo gsang ba'i bsgrub thabs 'phrin las/ dpal phyag na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dza ba ri pas mdzad pa/ bsad pa mi bsad bdud rtsis gsol ba/ bdud rtsi 'o ma'i mchod pa/ mdze nad kyi mtshan nyid/ rim pa drug pa rtags gsal bar byed pa/ dza ba ri pa rnams chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ gzungs kyi gtor ma'i cho ga dza ba ri pas mdzad pa/ she'u badzra dhe ba'i 'gyur te/ dza ba ri pa'i bskor 'di rnams/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud yin yang*/ phyag na rdo rje'i zlas drangs nas skabs 'dir bsgrigs so// de nas phyag na rdo rje mdo lugs su grags pa la/ gos sngon po can gyi gzungs kyi 'grel pa/ de kho nyid gsal bar byed pa'i sgron ma/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rgya brtson seng gi 'gyur/ gzungs kyi bsgrub thabs su bha shrī kirtis mdzad pa/ brtson seng gi 'gyur gzungs bsgrubs su bha sha kirtis mdzad pa brtson seng gi 'gyur/ bum pa'i bsgrub thabs su bha ki sha kirtis mdzad pa/

shes par byed pa'i don 'grel sgron ma/ su wa ki sha kirtis mdzad pa/ de kho na nyid sgron ma su wa ki sha kirtis mdzad pa/ spur bsad lang bsdus pa su wa ki sha kirtis mdzad pa/ dngos grub thams cad nye bar byed pa/ mchod rten gyi man ngag tai lo pas mdzad pa/ phyag na rdo rje mdo lugs kyi man ngag lag du blang ba'i rim pa/ birya tsan tras mdzad pa/ phyag na rdo rje'i bsgrub thabs/ shra ta ka ra war mas mdzad pa/ rnam thos sras gsang ba'i bsgrub thabs/ dga' rab rdo rjes mdzad pa/ gos sngon can gyi bsgrub thabs/ gtor ma'i man ngag /gzungs kyi gtor ma'i cho ga su bha kirtis mdzad pa/ yan lag bdun pa su bha girtis mdzad pa/ bsgrub pa'i go rims su bha kirtis mdzad pa/ gnod pa sel ba'i bdud rtsi bum pa kirtis mdzad pa/ gnod sbyin gyi bsgrub thabs/ ded dpon gyi bsgrub thabs/ 'khor lo'i man ngag byab cing yur ba'i las gsang ba/ spur bsad las tshogs bsdus pa/ rnams su bha sha kirtis mdzad pa/ lag na rdo rje'i bsgrub thabs/ birya tsan tras mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i rdo rje srin po'i bsgrub thabs/ bya'i gdong pa can gyi 'gyur/ gos sngon po can gyi bsgrub thabs yid bzhin nor bu nyin byed rdo rjes mdzad pa/ gzhon nu bum pa'i 'gyur/ gos sngon po can gyi bsgrub thabs/ stong nyid ting nge 'dzin tri'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa ba ri'i 'gyur/ phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga stong nyid ting nge 'dzin snying rje'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa ba ri'i 'gyur/ rdo rje snying po'i man ngag bsgrub pa'i thabs/ dzña na shris mdzad pa/ rig sngags gtad pa'i cho ga /tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ de kho na nyid kyi sgrol ma'i rtsa ba/ dang pos byin gyis mdzad pa rnams bzhugs/ (zhi)pa la de'i 'grel pa dpa' bo byin gyis mdzad pa rnams so// de nas bha ma'i bskor la/ rdo rje me lce'i rgyud le'u bcu gnyis kyi 'grel pa/

de kho na nyid snang ba gzhon nu tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ phyag na rdo rje lce babs kyi 'grel pa mu tig phreng ba rgyal po sprin gyi shugs can gyis mdzad pa mar pa'i 'gyur/ lce dbab pa'i bya thabs rten 'brel gyi mthus bsrung ba/ lce dbab kyi gsang ba yang khol gyi bsgrub thabs/ rgyal po sprin gyi shugs can gyi mdzad pa mar pa'i 'gyur/ rnal 'byor gyi spyod lam brgyad pa/ sprin gyi shugs can gyis mdzad pa mar pa'i 'gyur/ phyag na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bha bas mdzad pa gzhon nu tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ gos sngon can gyi dkyil chog gzhan gcig yang dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bha bas mdzad pa tshul khrims gzhon nu'i 'gyur/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga dang*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i sbyor ba brgyad pa bha bas mdzad pa/ gtor ma'i cho ga sbyor ba bcu gcig pa bha bas mdzad pa/ zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi'i cho ga bha bas mdzad pa/ 'phrin las bzhi'i bsgrub pa'i las kyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga bha bas mdzad pa/ las kyi rim pa mu tig gi phreng ba/ slob dpon bha bas mdzad pa gzhon nu tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje las kyi tshogs rim par phye ba'i cho ga bha bas mdzad pa/ sbyor kha chen po'i man ngag bha bas mdzad pa/ bsgrub thabs chen po bha bas mdzad pa rnams gzhon nu tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ gos sngon can gyi bsgrub thabs chung ba/ gos sngon can gyi bsgrub thabs bha ba'i man ngag chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ gos sngon can gyi bsgrub thabs chen po bha bas mdzad pa/ gzhon nu tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ phyag na rdo rje'i bsgrub thabs/ ba su dza nas bha tras mdzad pa/ phyag na rdo rje'i mdzad pa'i me lce'i bsgrub thabs/ phyag na rdo rje'i bsgrub thabs nag po'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa rnams so// phyag na rdo rje 'gro bzang gi bskor la/ phyag na rdo rje'i bsgrub thabs 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa 'phags pa shes rab kyi 'gyur/

gtor ma'i cho ga sbyin sreg gi cho ga rdzas dang*/ sngags dang*/ sman gyi 'khrul 'khor/ bsgrad pa'i 'khrul 'khor bsnun pa'i 'khrul 'khor/ gos sngon can gyi cho ga rin po che'i 'phreng ba/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi 'gyur/ rnam thos sras kyi bsgrub thabs/ shu rang ka warmas mdzad pa/ rnam thos sras bde byed kyi rtag pa 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa/ bāe sha wa na'i rtog pa/ rgyal po'i gtor ma'i rim pa/ pra dbab pa'i rim pa/ phyir bzlog pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rnam sras kyi drag byed kyi cho ga rnam thos sras kyi las rtag pa'i bsgrub thabs/ 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa rnam thos sras kyi bsgrub pa'i thabs/ nor 'phel ba/ 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa rnams 'phags pa shes rab kyi 'gyur ro// dpal phyag na rdo rje gtum po'i bskor la/ gos sngon po can gyi gzungs kyi 'grel pa/ karma badzras mdzad pa/ rdo rje gtum po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mdor bsdus pa las kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa/ dar ma tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ khro bo gtum po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga klu grub kyis mdzad pa/ phyag na rdo rje'i lam yan lag brgyad pa/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ dpal phyag na rdo rje'i las kyi bsgrub thabs/ las kyis rdo rjes mdzad pa/ phyag na rdo rje'i yan lag bdun pa/ klu gtor gtum chung*/ khra thogs ma'i bsgrub thabs rgyal po zla ba'i snying pos mdzad pa/ rdo rje khyung gi bsgrub thabs/ rdo rje pad mas mdzad pa rma ban gyi 'gyur/ khro bo'i rgyal po gos sngon po can gyi bsgrub thabs/ slob dpon pu tsa na badzras mdzad pa chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur khro bo rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bsgrub thabs/ sbyin sreg gtor ma'i cho ga bsrung ba'i cho ga las thams cad pa rnams/ slob dpon bha pu da ras mdzad pa/ pradzña shri dzña na kir ti'i rang 'gyur/ rdo rje gnam lcags mchu'i bskor la/ de'i bsgrub thabs bsnyen pa/

thun bkrad pa/ gsad pa/ mchod pa/ char dbab pa/ ser ba bsrung ba/ sbyin sreg rnams me tri bas mdzad pa/ de'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rnams so// rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i skor la/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs kyi bshad pa rdo rje sgron ma/ pad ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs kyi 'grel pa phyi ma/ bho de sa tas mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs kyi 'grel pa gsal ba'i sgron ma/ ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa/ dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba las/ rin chen bzang pos rgya dpe la btugs pa/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i don phye ste bshad pa bi ma las mdzad pa/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs kyi don rnam par bshad pa/ bde ba'i myu gus mdzad pa/ dkyil 'khor drug gi cho ga rin po che'i mig /thur shu rang ga badzras mdzad pa rnams bzhugs/ (zi)pa la rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa/ sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa mañdzu shri warma'i 'gyur/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs kyi 'grel pa/ sa ba ris mdzad pa chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur rdo rje rnal 'joms gyi 'grel pa jo bo smri tis mdzad pa/ rnam 'joms kyi gzungs kyi man ngag smri tis mdzad pa/ de nyid kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i khrus kyi cho ga'i lag len gzhan la phan pa/ rad na shri'i mdzad pa tshul ge rin chen gyi 'gyur/ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi cho ga mdor bsdus pa/ rad na shi las mdzad pa tshul ge rin chen gyi 'gyur/ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi khrus kyis cho ga ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa/ sbyin sreg cho ga rdo rje go chas mdzad pa/ rnam 'joms kyi gzugs kyi cho ga zhib mo dang bcas/ ku ma ra se nas mdzad pa/ rnams 'joms gzungs kyi bsgrub thabs/ dpa' bo gcig pa sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa rnam 'joms kyi man ngag las kyi thabs bhu dha ghu hyas mdzad pa/

gzungs kyi gtor ma'i cho ga gzungs kyi gsang bas mdzad pa/ rnam 'joms kyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhib mo sangs rgyas gsang ba'i mdzad pa/ mañdzu warma'i 'gyur/ rnam 'joms kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /dga' ba'i sgron ma/ rdo rje go chas mdzad pa pu rangs bsod nams blo gros kyi 'gyur/ rnam 'joms kyi rim pa'i cho ga'i rim pa/ rdo rje go chas mdzad pa/ rnam 'joms kyi khrus kyi cho ga rdo rje go chas mdzad pa/ rnam 'joms kyi dkyil 'khor cho ga rin chen snang ba/ sa ba ris mdzad pa/ rdo rje rnam 'joms gtum po'i bsgrub thabs sa wa ri pas mdzad pa/ rdo rje khro bos bsad pa'i 'phrin las sa wa ri pas mdzad pa/ sbyin sreg sa ra mi tas mdzad pa rnams chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i bsgrub thabs mdor bsdus/ tsan tra go mis mdzad pa/ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi bsgrub thabs/ ga ga dha ras mdzad pa/ cog gru rab zhi'i 'gyur/ rdo rje rnam 'joms gzungs kyi bsgrub thabs/ bram ze ma ni badzras mdzad pa/ rdo rje rnam 'joms ma bstod pa/ ma ṇi badzra mdzad pa/ rnam 'joms kyi bum chog zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga gtor ma'i cho ga las bzhi bsgrub pa'i cho ga ma ṇi badzras mdzad pa/ rdo rje rnal 'joms las bzhi bsgrub pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga dzña ba shris mdzad pa/ las bzhi bsgrub pa'i bum pa'i cho ga dzña na shris mdzad pa/ las bzhi bsgrub pa'i 'khor lo'i cho ga dzña na shris mdzad pa/ rnam 'joms kyi las bsgrub pa'i cho ga bram ze ma ṇi badzras mdzad pa/ las sna tshogs bsgrub pa'i cho ga rnams rab zhi'i 'gyur/ las kyi mtha' bco brgyad pa'i man ngag /rdo rje go chas mdzad pa/ rnam par 'joms pa'i khrus kyi cho ga byang chub snying pos mdzad pa/ rnam 'joms kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dza ya warmas mdzad pa/ rnam 'joms kyi bsgrub thabs las dang bcas pa/ ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa/ slob dpon ye shes rdo rje dang*/

slob dpon pad ma dang*/ mar me mdzad rnams kyis mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga dang bcas pa'i bsgrub thabs/ brgya rtsar grags pa rnams bzhugs/ de dag ni dpal phyag na rdo rje'i bskor rnams rim par phye ba'o// de nas spyan ras gzigs kyi bskor la/ tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /bstod pa bsgrub thabs gsum/ slob dpon mkhas pa chen po mdze ta ri dgra las rnam par rgyal bas mdzad pa lce dga' dpal gyi 'gyur/ rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po lha lnga bcu pa'i 'grel pa dri med dpal bzang pos mdzad pa/ rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga /bhi la shri las mdzad pa/ rigs kyi 'jig rten dbang phyug gi bsgrub thabs/ ma he lhas mdzad pa gsum/ yar klungs pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ spyan ras gzigs phyag stong pa'i bsgrub thabs/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ phyag stong spyan stong gi bsgrub thabs/ ta tha ga ta badzras mdzad pa khyung grags kyi 'gyur/ 'jig rten dbang phyug yid bzhin nor bu 'khor los bsgyur ba'i bsgrub thabs/ mdze ta ris mdzad pa rnam snang rdo rje bla ma'i 'gyur/ 'jig rten dbang phyug zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'i bsgrub thabs/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/ thugs rje chen po'i bsgrub thabs yid bzhin nor bu/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa la mchog dbyangs kyi 'gyur/ yi ge drug pa'i bsgrub thabs su dza badzras mdzad pa/ seng ge sgra'i bsgrub thabs/ chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ don yod zhags pa'i bsgrubs thabs mdor bsdus pa don zhags kyi gtor ma'i cho ga gso sbyong gi cho ga gso sbyong blang ba'i thabs kyi man ngag rnams/ shākya shri bha tras mdzad pa rab mchog dpal gyi 'gyur/ yi ge drug pa'i rim pas dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'khor lo bstan pa'i bsgrub thabs/ gzhan nu 'od kyi 'gyur/

yi ge drug pa'i bsgrub thabs/ mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ rta mgrin gyi bsgrub thabs/ mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ rta mgrin gyi sho na ma bzhi'i bsgrub thabs/ mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ padma'i dge bsnyen dang*/ grags pa'i lha dang*/ shing gzo ba dang*/ bud med dang*/ su ka dhe bas thugs rje chen po grub pa'i gtam rgyud rnams/ bi na shrī'i 'gyur/ po ta la'i lam yi ge ji snyed pa dharma yon tan gyi 'gyur/ lta spyod rnam dag yi ge drug pa'i man ngag 'pho ba dang bcas pa gsum/ kha che paṇa chen gyi mdzad pa/ sems nyid ngal so mi tri a nan tas mdzad pa/ 'ching ba rnam grol gyi man ngag mi tra a nan tas mdzad pa/ sems rin po che sbyong ba'i lam/ 'bras bud dha shri dzña nas mdzad pa/ byams pa dpal gyis bsgyur ba rnams/ spyan ras gzigs kyi bskor rim par phye ba'o// 'jam dpal gyi bskor la/ bstod pa mtshan brjod kyi skabs su smos nas/ dpa' bo gcig tu bsgrub pa'i 'grel pa/ su bha ka ras mdzad pa/ dha na shi la'i 'gyur/ dpa' bo gcig du grub pa'i bsgrub thabs/ dge ba'i 'dod 'jo/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa 'gos lha btsas kyi 'gyur/ dpa' bo gcig du grub pa'i bsgrub thabs/ mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ 'jam dpal gyi bsgrub thabs/ ma tis mdzad pa dha na shi la'i 'gyur/ a ra tsa pa tsa na'i bsgrub thabs/ shra dha ka ra warmas mdzad pa bsgrub thabs kyi cho ga /a ra pa tsa na'i mchod pa'i cho ga nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ mtshan brjod bsgrub thabs mi g.yo seng ges mdzad pa/ mar do'i 'gyur/ a ra pa tsa na'i bsgrub thabs/ slob dpon mi pham bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'jam dpal rdo rje blo gros 'phel ba slob dpon klu grub kyis mdzad pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi bsgrub thabs/ slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/

gnyan dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs shes rab 'khor lo'i bsgrub thabs/ zla ba'i 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa byams pa dpal gyi 'gyur/ 'jam dpal g.yo ba'i 'khor lo'i man ngag /shākya shrī bha tras mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal dmar po gsung gi bsgrub thabs/ rje ka ma la shris mdzad pa ste/ 'jam dpal gyi bskor rim par phye ba'o// de nas sgrol ma'i bskor la/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i bstod pa don thams cad grub pa/ ma tri tsi tras mdzad pa/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma la bstod pa ma ti tsi tras mdzad pa/ seng ge ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma la bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa bcu drug pa/ mdzes ma gzhon nu ma/ klu grub kyis mdzad pa/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma la bstod pa me tog gi phreng ba/ 'chi med zla bas mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ 'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod pa mu tig phreng ba/ tsan tra go mis mdzad pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ sgrol ma la 'jigs pa brgyad las bsgrol bar bstod pa/ lha mo sgrol ma la bstod pa/ sgrol ma la bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa bcu gnyis pa/ tsan tra go mis mdzad pa/ sgrol ma la bstod pa phrin las thams cad grub pa'i/ tsan tra go mis mdzad pa/ me tog phreng 'dzin gyi bstod pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyi bstod pa/ nyi ma grags dang chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/ me tog phreng 'dzin gyi bstod pa tshag bar bdun pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ zla ba gzhon nus rang 'gyur byas pa/ sgrol ma la smre sngags kyi gsol 'debs kyi bstod pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa byams pa dpal lo tsā'i 'gyur/ sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa cig la bstod pa rnam dag gtsug gi nor bu/ nyi ma sbas pas mdzad pa rgya brtson seng gis bzhed cing bla ma bai ro tsa na'i phyag dpe la yang gtugs pa/ rdo rje phag mo sgrol ma la bstod pa/ zla ba grags pas mdzad pa/

sgrol ma khro mo la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bstod pa/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma la/ jo bo rjes bstod pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma la nyi ma sbas pas bstod pa 'dan ma tshul khrims seng ge'i 'gyur/ 'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod pa/ mar me mdzad bzang pos bstod pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod pa akṣo bhya badzras mdzad pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod pa/ ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa/ rin chen grags kyi 'gyur/ gnas chen gyi rim pa'i lha mo sgrol ma la bstod pa/ mi skyod rdo rjes mdzad pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod pa/ 'bum phrag gsum pas mdzad pa/ dpal chen mo sgrol ma'i bstod pa tsan tra go mis mdzad pa blo gros rgyal pos bsgyur ba las nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis dag par byas pa/ sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'i bsgrub thabs las kyi yan lag dang bcas pa/ nyi ma sbas pas mdzad pa blo gros grags pa'i 'gyur/ sgrol ma'i bsgrub thabs man ngag gi rim pa u rgyan nas byung ba/ nyi ma sbas pas mdzad pa/ kha che paṇa ṭi tas spyan drangs pa'i dpe sa skyar 'gyur ba/ sgrol ma'i bsgrub thabs dam pa rnams bzhugs/ ('i)pa la bstod pa nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'i bsgrub thabs nyi ma sbas pa'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ byams pa dpal bo 'gyur/ lha mo sgrol ma'i bsgom pa'i cho ga rgyas pa/ mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ me tog 'phreng 'dzin gyi bsgrub thabs/ ta tha ga ta rakṣi tas mdzad pa/ stong nyid bsgom pa/ log par blta ba sun dbyung ba/ chom rkun bcing ba/ rig pa bskyed pa/ 'chi ba bslu ba rnams/ ta tha ga ta rakṣi tas mdzad pa rnams mya ngan med pa'i dpal gyi 'gyur/ me tog 'dzin gyi bstod pa bsgrub thabs dang bcas pa/ ratna rakṣi tas mdzad pa grub pa dpal gyi 'gyur/ seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma'i bsgrub thabs/ klu grub kyis mdzad pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi 'gyur/

'jig pa brgyad las skyob pa/ mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ sgrol ma dkar mo'i bsgrub thabs/ ngag dbang grags pa'i slob mas mdzad pa ba ri'i 'gyur/ 'jigs pa brgyad las bskyob pa'i bsgrub thabs/ tsan tra go mas mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba las/ blo gros grags pas bcos pa/ sgrol ma'i bsgrub thabs/ mar me mdzad ye shes kyi mdzad pa/ sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyi mdzad pa byams pa dpal lo tsā'i 'gyur/ sgrol ma yid bzhin nor bu'i bsgrub thabs/ bha ba bha tras mdzad pa/ chom rkun bcing ba rakṣi tas mdzad pa/ sgrol ma'i khrus chog bha ba bha tras mdzad pa/ maṇḍal gyi cho ga snying rje chen pos mdzad pa/ gso sbyong blang ba'i cho ga bha ba bha tras mdzad pa tshe 'phel ba'i cho ga /tsan tra go mis mdzad pa/ sgrol ma'i mchog bsgrub pa/ bsod snyoms bas mdzad pa rnams grub pa dpal bzang po'i 'gyur/ sgrol ma phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig 'don thabs dang*/ 'chi kha ma'i nyams len shākya shrīs mdzad pa byams pa dpal lo tsa'i 'gyur/ dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa'i cho ga /bha ba bha tras mdzad pa zhang grub pa dpal gyi 'gyur/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga mdor bsdus pa/ sa ra hi tas mdzad pa 'jam dpal sgeg pa rdo rje'i 'gyur/ rdo rje sgrol ma'i bsgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa/ chag dgra bcom gyi 'gyur/ u rgyan gyi rim pa'i sgrol ma'i bsgrub thabs/ mkha' 'gro ma bde ldan pas gsungs pa/ shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa sgrol ma'i bsgrub thabs/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ dge slong 'phags pas rgya'i yul cong dho'i mkhar du bsgyur ba/ rje btsun sgrol ma'i bsgrub thabs/ mar mer mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ shākya shrīs mdzad pa sgrol ma'i bsgrub thabs/ bi su ta tsan tra'i 'gyur/

sgrol ma'i bsgrub thabs brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ tsan tra go mis mdzad pa/ tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba la/ blo gros grags pas bsgyur ba/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rim pa rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i bsgrub thabs/ gzhon nu 'od kyi 'gyur/ sgrol ma lha dgu'i bsgrub thabs lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ sgrol ma'i mngon par rtogs pa/ mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ ku ru ku le'i bsgrub thabs gzhon nu 'od kyi 'gyur/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rjes su spyod pa'i gnod sbyin mo'i bsgrub thabs/ dar ma blo gros kyi 'gyur/ rgya nag sgrol ma'i bsgrub thabs/ gtor chog /sgrol ma'i blo 'phel gyi man ngag /klu grub kyis mdzad pa rnams dha na shi la'i 'gyur/ ral gcig ma'i bsgrub thabs mi pham sbas pas mdzad pa/ ral gcig ma'i bsgrub thabs rol pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa gnyis byams pa dpal lo tsa'i 'gyur/ ral gcig ma'i bsgrub thabs badzra kirtis mdzad pa/ ral gcig ma dmar mo'i bsgrub thabs/ legs pa'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ ral gcig ma dmar mo'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga /nag po spyod pas mdzad pa gzhon nu shes rab kyi 'gyur/ ral gcig ma dkar mo'i bsgrub thabs/ rol pa'i sbas pas mdzad pa paṇa ḍi ta chen po dha na shi la'i 'gyur/ 'od zer can gyi bsgrub thabs/ a sho ka shri yis mdzad pa/ lha mo 'od zer can gyi bsgrub thabs/ slob dpon kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi bsgrub thabs/ mdze ta ri dgra las rgyal bas mdzad pa/ chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ de rnams rje btsun sgrol ma la sogs lha mo'i bskor rim par phye ba'o// de nas gzungs kyi bskor la/ gtsug gtor dri med kyi gzungs rnam par bshad pa/ lhan cig gi skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa/ langs po tshul khrims brtsegs pa'i 'gyur/

gtsug gtor dri med kyi gzungs de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam tshig bsrung ba'i bsgrub thabs/ dri med 'od kyi gzungs kyi cho ga /rgyas bsdus gnyis ti paṃ ka ras mdzad pa// bi ma la u ṣṇi sha'i mchod rten bsgrub pa'i cho ga /zhi ba'i snying pos mdzad pa/ kun nas sgor 'jug pa'i gtsug gtor dri ma med pa'i mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa shan ta rakṣis tas/ khri srong sde btsan gyis don du mdzad pa/ gtsug gtor rnam par rgyal ba'i bstod pa tsan tra go mis mdzad pa/ 'phags pa gdugs dkar can las bstod pa/ ghi ri wa tas mdzad pa/ gtsug gtor rnam rgyal gyi bsgrub thabs/ rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa ba ri lo tsa'i 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug gtor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can gyi 'grel pa/ shu rang ga badzras mdzad/ gzungs 'don pa'i cho ga /shu rang ka badzras mdzad pa gnyis 'phags pa shes rab kyi 'gyur/ gdugs dkar can gyi nye bar bshad pa/ rdo rje gdan pas/ rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa ba ri'i 'gyur/ gdugs dkar mo can gyi cho ga tsan tra go mis mdzad pa/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi 'gyur/ gdug dkar mo can gyi gtor ma'i cho ga /tsan tra go mis mdzad pa rin chen ba so'i 'gyur/ gdugs dkar mo can gyi phyir bzlog pa'i gzungs kyi bsgrub thabs/ tsan tra go mis mdzad pa/ bsrung 'khor/ 'khrul 'khor/ bzlog pa'i thabs/ bgegs bzlog cing gzir ba'i cho ga /pha rol gyi dmag dpung gzhom pa'i thabs/ dngos grub bsgrub pa'i thabs/ 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i thabs/ ser ba bsrung ba'i thabs/ nad gdug pa can gso ba'i thabs/ gtor ma'i cho ga gdugs dkar can bsgrub thabs kyi cho ga /ghir ti wa tas mdzad pa/ sbyin bsreg gi cho ga rdo rje rnon pos mdzad pa/ rims bsrung ba'i cho ga /gor bsrung ba'i cho ga /tsan tra go mis mdzad pa/ zhi ba dang*/ mngon spyod dang dbang gi sbyin sreg /sri'u gso ba/ bzlog pa'i zor chog rnams tsan tra go mis mdzad pa/

gdugs dkar can gyi gzungs kyi bsgrub thabs/ bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa/ gdugs dkar can gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i gzungs kyi bsgrub thabs/ glo bo lo tsha bas bsgyur ba/ gdugs dkar can kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga pad ma'i lcags kyus mdzad pa 'phags pa shes rab kyi 'gyur/ rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga /pad ma'i lcags kyus sbyar ba chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ tsha tsha'i bya ba pad ma'i lcags kyus mdzad pa/ zangs dkar lo tsā'i 'gyur/ mchod rten bsgrub pa'i cho ga mdor bsdus pa/ tsan tra go mis mdzad pa/ stong mo rab du 'joms pa'i mdo'i 'bum 'grel dag pa lnga pa/ las kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rigs sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo'i 'bum 'grel/ las kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa rnams bzhugs/ (yi)pa la gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma'i mdo'i 'bum 'grel/ las kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa/ don yod rdo rje'i 'gyur/ bsrung ba lnga'i bsgrub thabs/ mdze ta ri pas mdzad pa dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/ stong chen mo/ rma bya chen mo/ gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma/ bsil ba mtshal/ so sor 'brang ma rnams so so'i bsgrub thabs/ 'dzi ta ri pas mdzad pa dar ma grags kyis bsgyur ba las/ chos kyi dbang phyug gis bcos pa/ so so 'brang ma'i 'khor lo bri ba'i cho ga /'dzi ta ri pas mdzad pa pradzña kitti'i 'gyur so so 'brang ma'i bsrung ba'i cho ga sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi gdam ngag pradzña kir ti'i 'gyur/ so so 'brang ma'i 'khor lo bri thabs shan ti bas mdzad pa/ bsrung ba lnga'i cho ga shan ti bas mdzad pa/ blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ so so 'brang ma'i 'khor lo'i sems byang*/ klu grub kyis mdzad pa nam mkha' rdo rje'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa tra byi la'i cho ga'i rim par phye ba/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /rad na kirtis mdzad pa ma ha pa na'i 'gyur/ bsgrub thabs thams cad kyi las ka gsal byed/ rad na kirtis mdzad pa/

gzungs thams cad kyi bsgrub thabs rim pa gnyis pa/ rin chen grags pas mdzad pa/ gzungs thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor cho ga kun snang gsal ba/ rin chen grags pas mdzad pa bal po ma ha pa na'i 'gyur/ bsgrub thabs spyi'i man ngag gsal por byed pa/ mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ legs par grub par byed pa'i bsgrub thabs/ byang chub mchog gis mdzad pa/ dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i bsgrub thabs/ ku mu ta/ a ka ras mdzad pa/ mi 'khrug pa'i dkyil chog dang bsgrub thabs/ sbyin sreg gsum/ ti pam ka ra shri dzña nas mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ mi 'khrug pa'i bsgrub thabs kyi cho ga /dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad pa/ mi 'khrug pa'i bsgrub thabs mdze ta ris mdzad pa rnams bzhugs/ (ri)pa la rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i cho ga zhib mo nāe wan rakṣi tas mdzad pa ste/ de rnams bya ba'i rgyud kyi bskor rim par phye ba'o// de dag ni rgyud sde bzhi so sor rtogs pa so so'i rim pa'o// de dag ni khongs su rtogs shing*/ de dag spyi'i yan lag bsgrub thabs sna tshogs su sdeb pa rnams dang*/ lta spyod la sna tshogs su ston pa/ grub mtha' las rim/ dkyil chog man ngag dam tshig ston pa rnams dang*/ de dag gi bka' bsrungs gi bskor rnams las// bsgrub thab sna tshogs rnams la/ ba ri'i bsgrub thabs brgya rtsar grags pa la/ rje btsun rdo rje gdan gyi bsgrub thabs kyi cho ga brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i bsgrub thabs slob dpon bha ba kan dhas mdzad pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi bsgrub thabs/ brtan pa'i 'khor lo rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ tshig lhug pa'i brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i bsgrub thabs/ tshig lhug pa'i a ra pa tsa na'i bsgrub thabs/ slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa/ a ra pa tsa na'i bsgrub thabs/ slob dpon mi pham bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi bsgrub thabs/

dpal 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i bsgrub thabs/ ngag gi rgyal po'i bsgrub thabs/ rgyal po chen po rol pa'i 'jam dpal gyi bsgrub thabs/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod du gsungs pa'i mdor bsdus pa'i 'jam dpal gyi bsgrub thabs/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod kyis bsdus pa'i 'jam dbyangs kyi bsgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal ye shes kyi sbyor ba/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi bsgrub thabs chos kyi dbyings ngag gi dbang phyug gi bsgrub thabs/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i bsgrub thabs/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal rdo rje dpa' bo gcig pa'i bsgrub thabs dge slong chos kyi grags pa'i 'gyur/ 'jam dpal shes rab 'khor lo'i bsgrub thabs/ 'phral du nyams su myong ba'i a ra pa tsa na'i bsgrub thabs/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i bsgrub thabs gnyis/ dpal rdo rje chos kyi bsgrub thabs/ slob dpon pu dza na pa tres mdzad pa/ ha la ha la'i bsgrub thabs/ lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa/ kha sar pa ne'i bsgrub thabs/ slob dpon rnyog pa med pa'i rdo rje mdzad pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs yi ge drug pa'i bsgrub thabs/ slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa/ ha ri ha ri la zhon par gyur pa'i spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi bsgrub thabs/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/ ha la ha la'i bsgrub thabs slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa pad ma gar gyi dbang phyug gi bsgrub thabs/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rim pa'i 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi bsgrub thabs/ slob dpon dgra las rnam par rgyal bar mdzad pa/ sgrol ma'i bsgrub thabs/ slob dpon rdo rje myu gus mdzad pa/ sgrol ma dkar mo'i bsgrub thabs/ slob dpon yid bzhin gyi nor bu rgyal pos mdzad pa/ seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma'i bsgrub thabs/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/

bdag med ma'i mchod pa'i cho ga /sgyu ma chen mo'i bsgrub thabs/ sgyu ma chen mo'i bsgrub pa'i thabs kyi cho ga /sgyu ma chen mo'i rgyud kyi bsgrub thabs/ sgyu ma chen mo'i rgyud kyi gtor ma'i cho ga rdo rje nag po chen po'i rgyud kyi bsgrub thabs/ nag po chen po'i bsgrub thabs rdo rje nag po chen po'i bsgrub thabs/ ku beḥka ru a bi dha na'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rnams/ paṇḍi ta shi la tsan tra dang*/ lotstsha ba dge slong tshul khrims 'byung gnas sbas pas bsgyur ba'o/ (li)pa la snying po dang nye snying la brten pa/ dgyes rdor dang bde mchog dbyer med par bsgrub thabs ldom bas mdzad pa/ mi g.yo ba'i bsgrub thabs khar kas mdzad pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i bsgrub thabs/ arya de bas mdzad pa/ bde mchog 'khor lo'i bsgrub thabs bhu su kus mdzad pa/ tshe dpag med kyi bsgrub thabs/ ka ma lis mdzad pa/ dzam pa la'i bsgrub thabs/ kaṃ pa ris mdzad pa/ dpal bde chen bsgrub pa ka la yas mdzad pa rnams/ paṇḍi ta ratna pha las rang 'gyur du mdzad pa/ byams pa'i bsgrub thabs thogs med kyis mdzad pa 'brom ston gyi 'gyur/ rje btsun mi pham mgon po'i bsgrub thabs/ slob dpon ni ra tis mdzad pa snubs byams pa dpal gyi 'gyur/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i bsgrub thabs/ slob dpon klu grub kyis mdzad pa gnyan gyi 'gyur/ shes rab snying po'i bsgrub thabs dha ris pas mdzad pa/ mi g.yo ba'i bsgrub thabs gser gling pas mdzad pa/ ti pa ka ra'i 'gyur/ mi g.yo ba'i bsgrub thabs mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ mi g.yo ba'i bstod pa gnyis mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ khro chen gtum po'i bsgrub thabs/ slob dpon pra ba kirtis mdzad pa/ khro chen gtum po'i bsgrub thabs/ pra bha ka ra kirtis mdzad pa/ da na shi la'i 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed kyi bsgrub thabs/

slob dpon a sho ka shris mdzad pa dang*/ des mdzad pa'i mi g.yo ba'i bsgrub thabs gnyis/ chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ mi g.yo ba'i bsgrub thabs spre brgyad ma/ pa tshab nyi ma grags kyi 'gyur/ mi g.yo ba'i 'khor lo 'dze ta ri pas mdzad pa/ dge tshul nam mkha' rdo rje'i 'gyur/ khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi bsgrub thabs// dpal nag po'i chen po'i bsgrub thabs/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i bsgrub thabs/ 'phags pa gnod sbyin gnod 'dzin gyi bsgrub thabs/ gnod sbyin nag po chen po'i bsgrub thabs dang lnga/ slob dpon las kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa/ gnod sbyin nag po chen po la rin po che'i bstod pa/ karna ri pas mdzad pa dang drug /glan dar ma tshul khrims kyis 'gyur/ klu dbang rgyal po'i bsgrub thabs/ klu grub kyis mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ dam tshig gsum bkod kyi yi ge brgya pa'i bsgrub thabs/ ke na ri pas mdzad pa tshub blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgrub thabs/ mngon shes can rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ yi ge brgya pa'i cho ga rin chen lcags kyu mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ lus ngan po'i bsgrub thabs/ dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ rnam thos sras kyi bstod pa thugs rje'i ba 'jo ma/ snyan ngag gi 'phreng ba/ u tsus ma'i bsgrub thabs/ thun mong ma yin pa sgeg pa rdo rjes mdzad pa/ dha na shi la'i 'gyur/ rmugs 'dzin la bstod pa btsun pa zla bas mdzad pa nyi ma grags kyi 'gyur/ rmugs 'dzin la bstod pa dzña na badzras mdzad pa/ dzam ba la la bstod pa nyi ma rnam par gnon pas mdzad pa/ grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ rmugs 'dzin 'chol pa'i man ngag gi bstod pa zla ba byang chub sems dpas mdzad pa/ rmugs 'dzin chu dbang la khyad par gyi bstod pa phrin las nyi shu pa/ slob dpon nor 'dzin dpal gyis mdzad pa/

byams pa dpal gyi 'gyur rmugs 'dzin gyi 'chol pa nag po'i bsgrub thabs sbas pa'i bum pa 'khyil pa/ slob dpon nor sbyin gyis mdzad pa/ byams pa dpal gyi 'gyur/ rmugs 'dzin 'chol pa'i bsgrub thabs/ nyi ma grags kyis bsgyur ba/ u btsus ma nor gyi bdag po'i bsgrub thabs/ 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ dha na shi la'i 'gyur/ dzam ba la dmar po'i bsgrub thabs/ 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ zhang grub pa dpal gyi 'gyur/ gnod sbyin a pa ra tsi ta'i bsgrub thabs rgyal po en tra bo tes mdzad pa/ tshogs kyi bdag po 'jur gegs sel ba'i bsgrub thabs/ en tra bo tis mdzad pa/ rgya brtson seng gi 'gyur/ gnod sbyin spun gnyis kyi bsgrub thabs/ a dzi ta mi tras mdzad pa snubs lotstsha'i 'gyur/ nor rgyun ma gsum gyi bsgrub thabs/ dha na shi la'i 'gyur/ lha mo nor rgyun ma la bstod pa dza ma ris mdzad pa rnams/ bsgrub thabs sna tshogs rim par phye ba'o// de nas lta spyod sna tshogs su ston pa rnams la/ sgrub snying gi skor dang*/ do ha'i bskor dang*/ grub pa rnams kyi glu'i bskor rnams las/ grub snying gi bskor rnams las/ grub pa'i sde/ snying po'i bskor/ sna tshogs brul tsho rnams las/ grub pa'i bskor/ rgyud ma lus pa'i dam pa'i don nges par bskul bar byed pa gsang ba grub pa pad ma badzras mdzas pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ thabs dang shes rab gtan la dbab par grub pa yan lag med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ 'gos lha btsas kyi 'gyur/ ye shes grub pa i tra bo tris mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur la tshul khrims rgyal bas rgya gar gyi dpe gsum la gtugs pa/ gnyis med grub pa lha mo dpal chen mos mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ dngos po gsal ba'i rjes su 'gro ba de kho na nyid grub pa'i bi la badzras mdzad pa/ lhan gcig skyes pa ḍoṃ bi he ru kas mdzad pa/

dpal u rgyan nas byung ba gsang ba chen po'i de kho na nyid kyi man ngag /dha ri ka pas mdzad pa 'gos lha btsas kyi 'gyur/ dpal de kho na nyid grub pa/ ke ra li pas mdzad pa chos 'bar gyi 'gyur/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rim pa'i man ngag /tog tse pas mdzad pa 'gos lha btsas kyi 'gyur/ bde ba chen po gsal ba a ba dhu ti pas mdzad pa/// /de nas snying po'i bskor la/ dpal rnyog pa med pa'i rgyud kyi bka' 'grel/ bikṣu ku ma ra tsan tras mdzad pa mtshur dzña na a ka ri 'gyur/ phyag rgya bzhi rjes su bstan pa klu grub kyis mdzad pa/ phyag rgya bzhi'i rgya cher 'grel pa rin po che'i snying po/ birya karmas mdzad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i phyag rgya rnam par bshad pa/ gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur lta ba ngan sel gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal po'i 'gyur/ lta ba ngan sel gyi 'grel pa gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ a ka ra'i 'gyur/ de kho na nyid rin po che'i phreng ba gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ theg pa chen po nyi shu pa/ gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa ratna a ka ra'i 'gyur/ de kho na nyid nyi shu pa gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ de kho na nyid rab du brtan pa mi phyed lnga pa/ dga' bcugs lnga pa gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ mtshur gyi 'gyur de kho na nyid bcu pa gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ de'i 'grel pa lhan cig skyes pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ mtshur gyi 'gyur/ sgyu ma nges par bstan pa/ rmi lam nges par bstan pa/ zung 'jug nges par bstan pa/ gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa'i tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ dho ha ti zhes pa de kho na nyid kyi man ngag /gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ thabs dang shes rab rtse ba lnga ba pa/ me tri pas mdzad pa mtshur gyi 'gyur/ rab tu mi gnas gsal bar ston pa/ gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/

lhan cig skyes pa drug pa/ gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa dzña na a ka ra'i 'gyur/ dbu ma drug pa gnyis med rdo rje mdzad pa/ yid la mi byed pa ston pa gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ chos 'bar gyi 'gyur/ dbang gi dgos pa mdor bsdus pa/ gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ rdo rje'i tshig badzra pa nis mdzad pa/ dzña na a ka ra dang gnyan chung gi 'gyur/ sgom rim drug pa pradzña ka la shri'i 'gyur/ gnas pa bsdus pa rma ban chos 'bar gyi 'gyur/ dbang bskur nges bstan mi tri bas mdzad pa/ tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ de'i bka' 'grel ra ma pha las mdzad pa/ tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba pa tshab kyis bcos pa/ shes rab ye shes gsal ba/ dhe ba tsan tra ka ras mdzad pa/ tshul khrims rgyal ba dang gnyan chung gis bsgyur ba/ grub thob brgya bcu rtsa lnga'i gsol 'debs/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa ding ri chos kyi grags pa'i 'gyur/ grub thob brgya bcu rtsa bzhi'i rtog pa'i snying po/ slob dpon dpa' bo 'od gsal gyis mdzad pa rnams bzhugs/ de dag ni grub snying gi skor rim par phye ba'o// de nas do ha'i bskor la/ (shi)pa la do ha mdzod ces bya ba'i de kho na nyid rnal du mtshon pa don dam pa'i yi ge /rma ban chos 'bar gyi 'gyur la/ tshul khrims rgyal bar zhu dag byas pa/ sku'i mdzod 'chi med rdo rje'i glu/ gsung gi mdzod 'jam dbyangs kyi glu/ thugs kyi mdzod skye med rdo rje'i glu/ sku gsung thugs yid la mi byed pa rnams/ sa ra ha'i zhal nas gsungs pa kri rna pa'i rang 'gyur/ do ha mdzod kyi bka' 'grel/ slob dpon gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ ba ri'i 'gyur la bāe ro tsa nas bcos pa do ha mdzod kyi bka' 'grel/ thar pa'i 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa rgya lo tstsha ba'i 'gyur/ nag po rdo rje zhabs kyi do ha mdzod kyi 'grel ba ri'i 'gyur/ mi zad pa'i gter mdzod man ngag gi glu/

sa ra has mdzad pa/ spyod pa'i glu sa ra has mdzad pa/ phyag rgya chen po 'chi kha ma'i man ngag /sa ra ha'i gdams pa/ mi zad pa'i gter mdzod yongs su gang ba'i glu/ sa ra has mdzad pa/ de'i rgya cher 'grel pa/ gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa pra dzña dzña na shri'i rang 'gyur/ ka kha'i do ha sa ra has mdzad pa bāe ro tsa na'i rang 'gyur/ rtse mo do ha sa ra has gsungs pa kra rna ba'i rang 'gyur/ tshigs su bcad pa'i mdzod/ tai lo pas mdzad pa bāe ro tsa na'i 'gyur ka kha do ha'i bshad pa bāe ro tsa na'i rang 'gyur/ chos thams cad rab du mi gnas pa'i ston pa/ de kho na nyid tshigs su bcad pa phyed kyi 'grel pa/ a ba dhu ti pas mdzad pa/ dngos po sbyong ba klu sgrub kyi mdzad pa/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i rab du byed pa/ arya de bas mdzad pa/ ma rtogs pa rtog par byed pa gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ snying po kun nas btus pa'i rab du byed pa/ a nan ta badzras mdzad pa chos 'bar gyi 'gyur/ bdud rtsi grub pa bir ba pas mdzad pa e te ba'i 'gyur/ phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag te lo pas na ro pa la gha gha'i gram du gsungs pa/ rang byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa sa ra has mdzad pa chos 'bar gyi 'gyur/ sems brtag pa tshul khrims 'phags pas mdzad pa/ chos 'bar gyi 'gyur/ man ngag gi tshigs su bcad pa bcu gnyis pa/ sa ra has gsungs pa/ dngos po'i gnas lugs bsgom pa nor bu gling pa bde ba'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ tshigs su bcad pa'i mdzod spyod pa bas mdzad pa/ chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ tshigs su bcad pa lnga pa nag po bas mdzad pa/ bāai ro tsa na'i 'gyur/ dpal rdo rje'i glu rnal 'byor spyod pa'i bsam gtan ka ro pas mdzad pa/ bir ba pa'i tshig rkang brgya bcu rtsa bzhi pa/ bāe ro tsa na'i 'gyur/ spyod pa'i glu'i mdzod kyi 'grel pa/ grub pa rnams kyi rdo rje'i glu gsal ba thub pas byin gyis mdzad pa/ grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/

lhan cig skyes grub slob dpon in tra bo tis mdzad pa dang*/ de nyid kyi gzhung 'grel lha lcam dpal mos mdzad pa dang*/ pradzña ghir te'i 'gyur/ snying po de kho na nyid rin chen che'i 'od ces bya ba/ slob dpon chen po nā ro pas mdzad pa rin chen rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ gdams ngag rin chen 'bru dgu paṇa chen shākya shris mdzad pa/ de nyid sku 'da' khar nam mkha' la byon pa'i tshig bcad/ rin chen dpal bzang pos bsgyur ba/ spur sbyangs pa'i tshe chu 'dzin gyis nga ro las byung pa'i byang chub kyi yan lag bdun pa/ paṇḍi ta phyed dang nyis rgya'i thugs las byung ba/ byams pa dpal gyi 'gyur/ gzhan yang de dag dang rjes su mthun pa/ thig le bcu drug gi nyams len zhes bya ba/ kang ka li pas mdzad pa/ phyi nang byang chub sems bcing pa'i man ngag bhi na pas mdzad pa/ rlung gi de nyid bsgom pa'i man ngag gho rakṣas mdzad pa/ rlung gi de nyid bsgom pa'i man ngag tso rang gi mdzad pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa bi ma bas mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i nyams len gyi thabs tan ti pas mdzad pa/ thabs shes rab gtan la dbab pa'i dngos grub bsdus pa tsa ma ris mdzad pa/ rang bzhin grub pa med pa phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len spangs ka las mdzad pa/ rtsa rlung gi sgo nas rnal 'byor gyi spyod pa ḍoṃ bi pas mdzad pa/ yi ge gnyis pa'i man ngag ldang gis mdzad pa/ de'i bde ba bsgom pa'i rjes su 'brang pa'i rnal bzhi'i man ngag klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ yig ge brgya pa'i sems dpa' gsum gyi bsgom thabs nā ro pas mdzad pa/ rin chen phreng ba si la a lis mdzad pa/ snying rje bsgom pa'i byin rlabs te lo pas mdzad pa/ sems kyi gros 'debs a dzu bis mdzad pa/ phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len ya sa ka las mdzad pa/ cha rlung gi sgo nas rnal 'byor gyi spyod pa ḍom bi pas mdzad pa/ yi ge gnyis pa'i man ngag ldang gis mdzad pa/

de'i bde ba bsgom pa'i rjes su 'brang pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i man ngag ku ku ri pas mdzad pa/ 'dzag pa spyod pa'i man ngag kun tsi bas mdzad pa rnams bzhugs/ (si)pa la mu stegs kyi gtum po a cin dhas mdzad pa gser 'gyur gyi rtsi na lis mdzad pa/ sems dang sems nyid 'dul ba'i thabs ne ko le gsungs pa/ lha kun gyi rdzogs pa'i rim pa bhun dha ris mdzad pa/ nyi zla bcing ba'i thabs ka ma ris mdzad pa/ sems kyi thig le'i hūṃ nyid bsgom pa'i rim pa dza lan dha ras mdzad pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgom pa ra hu las mdzad pa/ hūṃ yig sems nyid thig le bsgom pa'i rim pa/ dha ma pas mdzad pa/ rang bzhin grub pa'i thabs/ da ka ris mdzad pa/ lhan skyes zung 'jug gi gdams pa me dhi nis mdzad pa/ bla med sbyor ba'i rim pa bam ka dzas mdzad pa/ a li ka li'i man ngag rnal 'byor ghan dhas mdzad pa/ ka 'phreng bsgom pa'i lam dhu ma dhu pas mdzad pa/ a 'phreng ka 'phreng bde mchog bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor chen po bsgom pa sa ka ras mdzad pa/ rlung gnas nad kyi brtag pa an dzo kis mdzad pa/ sems nyid kyi de nyid bcing ba ko ta lis mdzad pa/ gtum mo'i thig le dgram pa u tsi kis mdzad pa/ lus kyi rtsa thig mnyam pa nyid kyi man ngag ne ku nis mdzad pa/ 'byung ba bzhi'i srid pa'i cha lugs slob dpon tsa ra sa tris mdzad pa/ rang rig ye shes kyi nyams len slob dpon tsam pa kas mdzad pa/ 'jigs pa brgyad rmongs par byed pa'i thabs/ slob dpon bhe kha nas mdzad pa/ phyi nang nad sel gyi gdams pa slob dpon tai lo pas mdzad pa/ g.yung drung 'khyil pa gsum gyi zhal gdams/ yum kang ka la me ka las gsungs/ lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin zhes bya ba slob dpon kan dha ris mdzad pa/ a ti'i rnal 'byor gyi bsgom pa'i man ngag /slob dpon klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad pa/ byang chub sems kyi rlung rgyu ba'i man ngag /slob dpon su ta lis mdzad pa/

lta spyod skye med kyi bsgom pa zhes bya ba slob dpon pa na has mdzad pa/ tshe bsgrub pa'i gdams ngag ces bya ba slob dpon ko ki las mdzad pa/ dug sel bsgom pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba/ slob dpon a rang gis mdzad pa/ gnyis med kyi rtsa bsgom pa zhes bya ba slob dpon nag po pa nas rgyud pa/ slob dpon ni la kan thas mdzad pa/ phra ba'i rnal 'byor gyi nyams len slob dpon sa mu tras mdzad pa/ phyi nang gi bcud len gyi gdams pa/ slob dpon bha ris pas mdzad pa rnams/ ratna pha las rang 'gyur du mdzad pa'o// rmi lam brtag pa bhi pu ta tsan tras bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/ rang bzhin dho ha mdzod kyi lta ba lu hyi pas mdzad pa/ rnam rtog yangs pa'i glu li las pas mdzad pa/ las kyi gtum mo'i do ha mdzod kyi glu bhi ba pas mdzad pa/ lta spyod bsgom pa 'bras bu'i glu sa ra ha pas mdzad pa/ do ha mdzod kyi de nyid kyi glu tha ka nas mdzad pa/ spyod pa'i do ha mdzod kyi glu kang ka nas gsungs pa/ lhan cig skyes pa'i do ha mdzod kyi glu lta ba bha des mdzad pa/ bde gshegs kyi lta ba'i glu dha ma pas mdzad pa/ rlung gi de nyid kyi do ha'i glu ma hi pas mdzad pa/ dpyid kyi thig le do ha mdzod kyi glu sa ra ha pas mdzad pa/ rdo rje bzhi'i glu a ba dhu ti pas mdzad pa/ me tri ba'i glu/ sa ra ha'i glu gnyis/ bi ru byed pa'i glu ka na sa'i glu /dhi dhi dzña na'i glu gnyis/ ka na ri'i glu gnyis/ ma ti tsi tra'i glu/ dpa' bo rnam par snang mdzad kyi glu nā ro pa'i glu/ dhum bi ba'i glu/ bi ru ba'i glu/ zla ba pa'i glu/ ma ha su ka ta'i/ pra sa ri'i glu/ klu sgrub kyi glu/ ti pam ka ra shri dzña na'i chos kyi glu/ do ha spyod pa'i glu'i lta ba ki ra pas gsungs pa/ stong pa nyid kyi lta ba sha ba ri pas gsungs pa/ bde sdug gnyis bral gyi lta ba shan bas gsungs pa/ 'bral med kyi lta ba kam pa las mdzad pa rnams rad na pha la'i rang 'gyur/

stong nyid snying rje'i lta ba tsa ta pas mdzad pas/ zhen med kyi lta ba ka pa las mdzad pa/ sems nyid rin chen gyi lta ba be ha nas mdzad pa/ de nyid brgyad kyi lta ba in tra bo dhis mdzad pa/ sems nyid rtog pa 'joms par byed pa lakṣi mas mdzad pa/ mya ngan gyi lta ba dha bu ris mdzad pa/ sems nyid kyi lta ba me tri bas mdzad pa/ snying rje'i spyod pa thod pa'i lta ba sa ra bha gas mdzad pa/ 'brel med kyi spyod pa nag po pas mdzad pa/ de bzhin nyid kyi lta ba dha ri ka pas mdzad pa/ spyod pa'i glu mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ de'i 'grel pa mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa nag tsho'i 'gyur/ chos kyi dbyings su lta ba'i glu ti pa ka ras mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ 'khor ba las yid nges par 'byung bar byed pa'i glu/ mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ rgya brtson seng gis bsgyur zhing*/ tshul khrims rgyal bas bcos pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi glu jo bos mdzad pa dang nag tsho'i 'gyur/ rdo rje gdan gyi rdo rje'i glu rtsa 'grel ti pam ka ra shri dzña nas mdzad pa/ phyag rgya chen po brda'i rgyud pa/ rje dam pa la bde bar gshegs pa bcu gnyis kyis gsungs pa zha ma lo tsā'i 'gyur/ brda'i man ngag ngo mtshar rgyud pa/ rnal 'byor pho mo lnga bcu rtsa bzhi'i dgongs pa dril ba dri me dngul rgong*/ gser rgong*/ shel rgong rnams mi pham mgon pos gsungs pa/ phyag rgya chen po rin chen brda'i man ngag zha ma lo tsā'i 'gyur mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gsang ba'i glu seng ge rgyal po'i 'gyur/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i 'gyur rnams zha ma'i 'gyur/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma brda'i 'gyur bam po bzhi pa zha ma'i 'gyur/ thugs kyi gsang ba glur blangs pa grub thob brgya bcu'i rtog pa brjod pa thig le dag pa'i phreng ba zha ma'i 'gyur/ grub thob lnga bcu'i rtog pa brjod pa'i thig le 'od kyi 'phreng ba zha ma'i 'gyur/

grub thob bzhi bcu'i 'gyur thig le gser gyi phreng ba ye shes mkha' 'gro ma sum bcu rtsa lnga'i rtog pa brjod pa/ mkha' 'gro ma'i 'byam glu/ bdag med ma'i brda rin po che'i man ngag gi tshor ba phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag /rdo rje gsang ba'i glu/ sa ra has gsungs pa/ seng ge rgyal po'i 'gyur/ lta ba/ spyod pa/ bsgom pa/ 'bras bu/ lam nyams gnad kyi brda/ mngon pa pa chen pos ka ma la shri la gsungs pa/ rnal 'byor pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid snang ba zhes bya ba'i rdo rje'i 'gyur le'u dgu pa rje dam rgya gar gyis rang 'gyur du mdzad pa/ byang chub spyod pa'i sgron ma/ rnal 'byor lam gyi sgron ma/ gsang ba thugs kyi sgron ma gsum rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ka ma la shris mdzad pa'o// bram ze chen po rmangs do ha lags pa do ha dang*/ rdo rje glu'i skor rim par phye ba'o/ sngags spyi'i lam rim dang*/ grub mtha'i bstan bcos las/ de kho na nyid grub pa zhes bya ba'i rab du byed pa/ zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ de nyid mthong ba'i lam ye shes rdo rje mdzad pa/ sdogs bud dha pa la'i 'gyur/ sngags kyi bsgrub pa'i lam gyi rim pa dang*/ sems kyi lam sbyong ba/ ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa le'u lnga pa glan dar ma blo gros kyi 'gyur/ theg pa chen po'i lam gyi rim pa le'u bzhi pa bskal pa bzang po rdo rjes mdzad pa/ shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur/ bla ma rgyud pa'i rim pa'i man ngag badzra pa nis mdzad pa/ 'brog mi jo sras kyi 'gyur// jo bos mdzad pa'i lta sgom che 'bring gsum/ me lam 'khyer/ chu lam 'khyer/ rlung lam 'khyer/ chu gtor gyi cho ga rnams jo bos mdzad pa/ brtson 'grus seng ge'i 'gyur/ glu gtor gyi cho ga jo bos mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ de kho na nyid la 'jug pa bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' lung mdor bsdus ste bshad pa/ dpal ye shes grags pas mdzad pa rnams bzhugs/

(hi)pa la de kho na nyid kyi snying po bsdus pa/ chos kyi dbang pos mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ gsang sngags kyi snang ba mtho btsun brtson legs kyis mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ gsang sngags la 'jug pa rab du byed pa drug bcu pa/ dzña na a ka ras mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ de'i 'grel pa ye shes 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa/ tshul khrims rgyal gyi 'gyur/ tshul gsum gyi sgron ma mtho btsun tri bi ka ma las mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ mtha' gnyis rnam par spong ba gsang ba'i grub mtha' dzña na shris mdzad pa/ las dang po ba'i sgron ma a nu pa mas mdzad pa bhu dha pa la'i rang 'gyur/ las dang po ba'i tshul rnyog med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ las dang po ba'i bya ba dharma a ka ra ma tis mdzad pa dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/ las dang po ba'i bya ba mdor bsdus pa gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ maṇḍal gyi cho ga sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ maṇḍal gyi cho ga gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ maṇḍal gyi cho ga ka ma las mdzad pa/ las dang po ba'i cho ga mdor bsdus pa rgyal ba me tri bas mdzad pa/ gtor ma'i cho ga bdud rtsi 'byung ba/ jo bos mdzad pa khu dngos grub kyi 'gyur/ gtor ma chen mo'i las kyi rim pa'i 'grel pa/ rdo rje mi skyod pas mdzad pa/ dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ cha gsum 'bring po'i cho ga shra ta ka ra warmas mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ chu gtor dri ma med ba'i gzhung*/ mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ rgyal po chen po gtor ma'i cho ga /dge bshes ston pa'i 'gyur/ 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ gtor ma'i cho ga nyung ngu/ rgyud sna tshogs las btus pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga dgu brgya pa las/ cho ga brgyad pa/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa gzhon nu tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/

gtor ma'i cho ga dza ya se nas mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ gtor ma'i 'grel pa bhin dha dzña nas mdzad pa rin chen mchog gi 'gyur/ chos skyong thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga bha ling a tsaryas mdzad pa/ rma ban chos 'bar gyi 'gyur/ glegs bam klog pa'i thabs dha na shi la'i rang 'gyur/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa 'don tshul gyi sngon 'gro'i sgrub thabs bhi pu dha tsan tras mdzad pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ yi ge brgya pa'i cho ga rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ dal spyi'i rim pa a pu bha tras mdzad pa rig pa gzhon nu'i 'gyur/ dal gyi cho ga rdo rje'i phreng ba cho ga lnga bcu pa/ a bhya ka ra gu pa tas mdzad pa/ 'khor lo grags kyi bsgyur ba las/ shes rab dpal gyis bcos shing chos rjes dpal gyi zhus dag byas pa/ rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi phreng ba stong nyis brgya pa/ 'jigs med 'byung nas sbas pas mdzad pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i dpal bzang pos rang 'gyur la chos rje dpal gyis bcos pa'i stod yan chod bzhugs/ (i)pa'i nang na de'i smad dang*/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'od kyi snye ma nyis brgya bdun bcu rtsa lnga pa/ 'jigs med 'byung nas sbas pas mdzad pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'gyur la chos rje dpal gyi bcos pa/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga a bhya ka ra gu pa tas mdzad pa/ zab mo'i dbang gi cho ga rin po che ni snye ma a bhya ka ra gu pa tas mdzad pa/ man ngag gi snye ma zhes bya ba rgyud thams cad kyi bskyed rdzogs gi man ngag thun mong du bstan pa/ a bhya ka ra gu pa tas mdzad pa rnams/ grub pa dpal bzang po'i 'gyur/ dbang bskur nges par bstan pa rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa/ rab gnas kyi cho ga mdor bsdus pa dad pa'i 'byung nas go chas mdzad pa/ nyi ma grags kyi 'gyur/ rab gnas kyi cho ga mdor bsdus pa/ paṇḍi ta mi 'jigs pa'i phyag gis mdzad pa/

tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i rim par phye ba he ru ka badzras mdzad pa gnyis grub pa dpal gyi 'gyur/ dbyug gu drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor ma grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur dal spyi'i rim pa kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa/ gsang ba thams cad kyi spyi'i cho ga snying po'i brgyan 'jam dpal grags pas mdzad pa/ nyi ma rdo rje'i 'gyur/ dal gyi cho ga mdor bsdus pa sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa gzhal yas khang gsal ba'i mngon rtogs mun sel sgron ma pad ma 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ dal gyi thig gdab pa mdor bsdus pa shra dha ka ra warmas mdzad pa dang*/ de'i rang 'grel rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur ba thig gdab pa'i rim pa dka' ba spyod pa shudhi pra bas mdzad pa/ thig gi cho ga slob dpon dharma kirtis mdzad pa/ rgyud sde chen po lnga'i dal cho ga de kho na nyid bsdus pa gsal ba/ dar ma blo gros kyis bsgyur ba la/ khyung po rnal 'byor gyi zhu thug byas pa/ bar ma do'i cho ga nā ro pas mdzad pa sdog budha bas bsgyur ba/ dbang gi don nges par brjod pa rgyal ba dpal bzang po sbas pa mdzad pa shākya brtson 'grus kyi 'gyur/ rnam pa lnga mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa shes rab grags kyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/ de rnams ni sngags spyi la phan pa'i bstan bcos kyi bskor rim par phye ba'o// de nas sngags spyi'i dam tshig gi bskor la/ (ke)pa la bla ma lnga bcu pa/ bha bī lhas mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur// rdo rje theg pa rtsa ba'i ltung ba bha bi lhas mdzad pa/ yan lag gi dam tshig dang bcas pa/ rdo rje theg pa rtsa ba'i ltung ba rgya cher bshad pa/ 'jam dpal grags pas mdzad pa/ de la phan pa'i yan lag dang bcas pa rgya brtson seng gi 'gyur/ rdo rje theg pa rtsa ba'i ltung ba rgya cher 'grel pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun snying po zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ 'o ru lo tsā'i ba'i 'gyur/ rdo rje theg pa rtsa ba'i ltung ba'i bka' 'grel pradzña ghirti'i 'gyur/

ltung ba sbom po rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa pradzña ghirti'i 'gyur/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi'i 'grel pa shan ti bas mdzad pa/ khyung grags kyi 'gyur/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi pa'i 'gre pa lakṣi ka ras mdzad pa/ rdo rje theg pa'i ltung ba'i snye ma a bhya ka ra gu pa tas mdzad pa sangs rgyas grags kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje theg pa rtsa ba'i ltung ba slob dpon dri med sbas pas mdzad pa dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba'i rgya cher 'grel pa rgyal ba'i lhas mdzad pa/ tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa'i ltung ba sbom po/ ltung ba bco lnga pa/ ltung ba sbom po klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/ las dang po ba'i dam tshig mdor bsdus pa/ dzña na bo dhis mdzad pa bsod nams rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ tshul khrims dang sdom pa dang*/ dam tshig dang mi 'gal ba ye shes dpal bzang pos mdzad pa rab zhi bshes gnyen gyi 'gyur/ dam tshig thams cad bsdus pa/ mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ de nyid kyis mdzad pa dam tshig kun gyi cho ga kun las btus pa le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga pa gyi jo zla ba 'od zer gyis bsgyur ba las/ tshul khrims rgyal bas gtan la phab pa ste/ sngags spyi'i dam tshig gi bskor rim par phye ba'o/// /de dag gi bka' bsrungs gi bskor la/ dpal nag po chen po'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa rta dbyangs kyi mdzad pa rna nam rdo rje bla ma'i 'gyur/ nag po chen po dpa' bo gcig pa'i bsgrub thabs sa man ta shris mdzad pa/ char dbab pa la sogs pa'i rim pa zhing skyong gi bsgrub thabs/ nag po chen po la gnod sbyin brgyad bskor bas bsad pa lags pas sa man ta shris mdzad pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i sbyin sreg sa man ta shris mdzad pa rnams chos rab kyi 'gyur/ dpal nag po chen po'i bsgrub thabs rtsa mi chen po'i 'gyur mgon po bya rog gdong can gyi nang bsgrub rtsa mi'i 'gyur/

dpal nag po chen po la bstod pa rkang pa brgyad pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rje btsun dpal nag po chen po la bstod pa/ sangs rgyas grags kyis bskul ba// bya rog gdong can la bstod pa sangs rgyas grags pas mdzad pa se lo tsā ba'i 'gyur/ nag po chen po la bstod pa mchog sred kyis mdzad pa/ nag po la bstod pa a ba dhu ti pas mdzad pa/ nag po chen po'i bsgrub thabs/ slob dpon rnam pa rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ nag po chen po'i bsgrub thabs sbyor ba dang bcas pa/ dpal stong pa'i ting nge 'dzin rdo rjes mdzad pa dpyal ser tsha'i 'gyur/ nag po chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa/ nag po chen po'i bsgrub thabs slob dpon bsod nams snyoms pas mdzad pa// pradzña ghirti'i 'gyur/ nag po chen po'i gtor ma'i cho ga /ti pam ka ra shri dzña nas mdzad pa 'brom ston pa'i 'gyur/ legs ldan nag po'i bsgrub thabs/ dal bdun gyi rim pa rnam par phye ba slob dpon snang mdzad myu gus mdzad pa/ dpal lha mo nag mo la bstod pa/ rkang pa brgyad pa/ bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa/ dpal lha mo nag mo chen mo'i bsgrub thabs/ lo ka shris bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs so// dpal ldan ma ha ka la dang*/ lha mo'i bskor rim pa phye ba'o/ de nas gsang sngags snying ma'i bskor la/ sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba/ dur khrod khu byug rol pa'i rgya cher bshad pa bdud rtsi thigs pa zhes bya ba/ slob dpon mtsho skyes rdo rjes mdzad pa/ gnyan ku ma ri'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa thabs kyi zhags pa padma'i phreng gi 'grel pa/ gsang snying gi 'grel pa/ nyi ma'i seng ge 'od kyis mdzad pa le'u bco lnga pa yan chod bzhugs/ (khe)pa la de'i smad dang yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ gsang snying gi 'grel bshad/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba le'u stong phrag brgya pa de nyid kyis mdzad pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i dbang gi gal po/

dbang gi don rab tu byed pa/ slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas gsang bas rab tu mdzad pa/ sgyu 'phrul thugs kyi theg pa/ gsang ba'i theg pa'i man ngag slob dpon bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa/ shes rab spyan 'byed kyi man ngag bi ma las mdzad pa/ man ngag gi rgyal po lta ba'i phreng ba/ las shan lta ba'i sgron ma bzhad pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ lta ba'i rim pa'i man ngag /ska ba dpal rtsegs kyis mdzad pa/ g.yu'i thang ma sras dgu/ bi ma las 'phan yul du gnya' la gtad pa'o// sgyu 'phrul dra me long lta bu'i bsgrub thabs/ slob dpon dzña na dza yas mdzad pa/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i 'od kyi rim pa'i man ngag /sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa sgyu 'phrul phyag rgya bsam gtan bi ma las mdzad pa/ lam rnam par bkod pa sangs rgyas gsang ba'i man ngag yul khri babs su dzña na ku ma ras bsgyur ba/ man ngag rnam par bkod pa/ thugs kyi thigs pa sgyu 'phrul spyi gcod/ sangs rgyas gsang ba/ bhi ma la mi tra/ sgeg pa rdo rje gsum gyis mdzad pa/ rma rin chen mchog gi 'gyur/ sgyu 'phrul man ngag gsal ba'i sgron me/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i lam bshad pa bhi ma la mi tras mdzad pa/ rim pa drug pa slob dpon sgeg pa rdo rjes mdzad pa/ man ngag rim pa gsum pa/ sems skyed pa'i cho ga mdor bsdus pa/ dam tshig gsal bkra sgeg pa rdo rjes mdzad pa/ sbyin sreg gi rim pa mdor bsdus pa bhi ma la mi tras mdzad pa/ ro bsregs las kyi phreng ba bhi ma las mdzad pa/ sgyu 'phrul pe chung rang gnas kyi rim pa sgeg pa rdo rjes mdzad pa/ sku gdung las kyi phreng ba/ za tshogs gtor ma'i mu gsang ba'i mdo don bsdus pa/ slob dpon dar ma bo des mdzad pa/ skabs 'grel bye brag rnam par bshad pa slob dpon sti ra ma tis mdzad pa/ byang chub sems kyi ljon shing sti ra ma tis mdzad pa/ yo ga rgyud phyi ma las nges don mdor bsdus te mdzad pa rgyan dam pa/ cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi/

rmad du byung ba'i mdo/ lta ba thams cad kyi rgyal po che ba rang la gnas pa'i rgyud/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa bla na med pa gsang ba rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud chen po/ rdo rje phur bu chos thams cad mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyud chen po dang*/ phur pa bcu gnyis 'byung ba'i rgyud chen po rnams bzhugs/ (ba)pa la 'phags pa rdo rje phur bu rtse mo'i chen po/ drag po rgyud pa'i phreng ba zhes bya ba dang*/ dpal khrag 'thung chen po mngon du 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud chen po dang*/ rdo rje phur bu'i rgyud phur pa rdo rje bkod pa rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gsang ba rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal las bzhi 'khor lo gsang ba'i rgyud/ 'phags pa thabs kyi zhags pa pad ma 'phreng gi don bsdus pa'i rgyud/ dur khrod khu byug rol pa'i rgyud gshin rje 'phrul 'khor rgyan me long 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi nyi ma bzhi pa gsang ba'i rgyud 'khor lo nag po/ gshin rje nag po'i rgyud/ gnod sbyin ro langs gsang ba'i rgyud/ nag po chen po zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po dang*/ 'phags pa rin chen dpung brgyan gyi rgyud/ dpal nag po chen po'i rtog pa dur khrod chen po'i rgyud/ nag po chen po'i rgyud dur khrod nag po zhes bya ba dang*/ dur khrod lha mo nag mo'i rang rgyud/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen mo ral pa gcig ma'i rgyud/ 'phags pa las bzhi 'khor lo gsang rgyud phyi ma rnams bzhugs/ (ma)pa la dpal dngos grub thams cad brtan par gzigs pa'i rgyud dang*/ de'i rgyud phyi ma dang*/ dpal thod pa nag po chen po'i rgyud dang*/ de'i rgyud phyi ma dang*/ dpal lha mo shan pa nag mo'i rgyud dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma me lce 'bar ba'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen mo/ ral pa gcig ma'i rgyud dang*/

de'i rgyud phyi ma dang*/ dpal thod pa nag po chen po'i rgyud dang*/ lha mo nag mo'i sngags rgyud dang*/ ma mo srog las kyi thig le'i rgyud dang*/ dpal ldan lha mo'i thugs gsang ba'i rgyud dang*/ dpal lha mo nag mo gnod sbyin dam can ma'i rgyud rnal 'byor gyi rgyud lung chen mo lha mo'i dngos grub bsgrub pa'i thabs dang*/ de'i rgyud phyi ma dang*/ phyi ma'i phyi ma mo/ byang chub sems gsang ba'i brgyud dang*/ lha mo nag mo dbang phyug ma'i sngags rgyud rnams bzhugs so/// /da ni nang rig pa ston pa gnyis pa mtshan nyid la/ theg pa chen po dang*/ theg pa chung ngu gnyis las/ theg pa chen po la/ bka' 'khor lo bar pa dang*/ tha ma'i dgongs 'grel gnyis yin pa la/ bka' 'khor lo bar pa'i dgongs 'grel la/ yul can mngon par rtogs pa'i cha dang*/ de dag gi yul lta ba'i cha gsal bar byed pa rnams dang*/ mngon par rtogs pa'i bsgom pa'i rim pa ston pa rnams dang*/ de dag gi rjes su spyod pa/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la ji ltar bslab pa'i tshul ston pa rnams dang*/ de dag dang rjes su mthun pa gtso bor ston pa/ gtam dang*/ spring yig /rtogs brjod sna tshogs kyi bskor rnams las/ yum can mngon par rtogs pa'i cha rnams gtso bor ston pa'i bskor la/ (kā)pa la mdo rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi 'grel pa/ mgon po byams pas mdzad pa/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan dang*/ de'i 'grel pa slob dpon seng ge bzang pos mdzad pa/ don gsal ba bam po lnga pa gnyis dpal rtsegs dang rngog lo'i 'gyur/ de'i 'grel bshad tshig rab du gsal ba/ slob dpon chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ rgyan gyi 'grel pa'i bsdus don shes rab 'byung gnas/ blo gros kyis mdzad pa blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i bsdus don ku ma shri badzras mdzad pa/

bkra shis rgyan gyi 'gyur/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel bshad rtogs par bka' ba'i snang ba/ slob dpon rigs kyi byin pas mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po dang*/ tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (khā)pa la mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel pa grags pa'i cha shas zhes bya ba slob dpon rin chen grags pas mdzad pa/ la chings yon tan 'bar gyi 'gyur/ mngon par rtogs pa'i brgyan gyi 'grel pa/ shes rab sgron ma'i 'phreng ba kha che'i slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal gyis mdzad pa byams pa dpal gyi 'gyur/ theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma 'phags pa mi pham pas mdzad pa le'u lnga pa dang*/ de'i 'grel pa slob dpon thogs med kyis mdzad pa blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ nges pa'i don de dag la skrag pa spangs pa'i phyir re shig rigs dang theg pa gsum du ston pa drang ba'i don gyi mdo thams cad kyi dgongs par byed pa'i bstan bcos mgon po byams pas mdzad pa mdo sde'i rgyan bam po gsum pa dang*/ de'i 'grel pa le'u nyi shu rtsa gcig stong drug rgya lnga bcu pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ (gā)pa la mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel chen du grags pa slob dpon blo brtan gyis mdzad pa bsgrub pa'i skabs kyi stod yan chad lce bkra shis kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (ngā)pa la de'i 'jug rdzogs pa dang*/ mdo sde rgyan gyi tshigs bshad dang po gnyis bshad pa paṇḍi ta gzhan la phan pas bshad pa/ gzhon nu mchog gi 'gyur/ mdo sde rgyan gyi don bsdus kha che dzña na shris mdzad pa/ dbus dang mtha' rnam par 'byed pa le'u lnga pa mgon po byams pas mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa ye shes rdo rje'i 'gyur/ de'i 'grel bshad slob dpon blo brtan gyis mdzad pa'i le'u gsum pa'i 'gog bden yan chad ye shes sde'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (cā)pa la de'i 'jug dang*/

chos dang chos nyid rnam par 'byed pa/ lhug pa dang tshig bshad gnyis mgon po byams pas mdzad pa/ chos dang chos rnam par 'byed pa'i 'grel pa/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 'bum tig le'u nyer lnga pa'i bstod pa yan chad bzhugs/ (chā)pa la de'i 'jug cung ma 'gyur ba dang*/ kha che dharmā shri'i bum tig yum gsum mthun par don brgyad kyis bstan pa smris tis mdzad pa de nyid kyi rang 'gyur/ shes rab snying po'i 'grel pa slob dpon padmas mdzad pa rnams bzhugs/ (jā)pa la/ 'bum tig ba po ti nyi shu rtsa bdun pa gzhung 'grel du grags pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ yum bar ma 'grel pa'i phyogs la/ nyi khri le'u brgyad la bsdus don gyi 'grel pa slob dpon seng ge bzang pos mdzad pa/ dum bu dang po'i bam po brgyad yan chad bzhugs/ (nyā)pa la de'i bam po dgu pa nas/ dum bu gnyis pa'i bam po bcu dgu yan chad bzhugs/ (tā)pa la/ dum bu bzhi pa'i bam po bcu gsum pa yan chad bzhugs/ (thā)pa la/ de'i 'jug yongs su rdzogs ye shes sde lags pa'i 'gyur la/ rngog lo tstsha bas bcos shing*/ gsal ba grags kyis zhus pa dang*/ nyi khri snang ba 'phags pa rnam grol sdes mdzad pa/ blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ nyi khri rnam 'grel lnga stong bzhi brgya pa btsun pa grol sdes mdzad pa'i lam shes yan chad/ 'bro seng dkar shākya grags kyis bsgyur ba bzhugs/ (dā)pa la de'i 'jug rdzogs pa dang*/ nyi khri dag ldan slob dpon shan ti nas mdzad pa/ shākya blo gros dang dge ba'i blo gros kyi bsgyur ba la 'go sa lha btsas kyi 'gyur bcos pa/ yum bsdus pa 'grel pa'i phyogs la/ 'phags pa brgyad stong pa'i 'grel chen/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi snang ba/ slob dpon bzang pos mdzad pa/ rin chen bzang po dang*/ blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur ba'i le'u bzhi pa yan chad bzhugs/

(nā)pa la de'i 'jug dang*/ 'phags pa brgyad stong pa'i rnam par bshad pa man ngag gi rjes su 'brel pa stong phrag brgyad pa dpal ldan rgya po dza gad ta lar gnas pas mdzad pa'i le'u dgu pa yan chad/ ga rod tshul khrims 'byung gnas sbas pas bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/ (pā)pa la de'i 'jug rdzogs pa dang 'phags pa brgyad stong pa'i 'grel pa snying po mchog rad na a ka ra shan ti bas mdzad pa/ shākya blo gros kyi bsgyur ba bzhugs/ (phā)pa la 'phags pa brgyad stong pa'i 'grel pa gnad kyi zla 'od a bhya ka ra pa tas mdzad pa shes rab dpal gyi 'gyur/ brgyad stong don bsdus slob dpon phyogs kyi glang pos mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa lnga brgya bzhi bcu pa slob dpon dkon mchog 'bangs kyis mdzad pa blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa tshigs su bcad pa'i bka' 'grel/ rtogs par sla ba slob dpon seng ge bzang pos mdzad pa/ 'bro seng dkar shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ bsdud pa'i bka' 'grel slob dpon bhud dha shris mdzad pa dpal rtsegs kyi 'gyur bam po gsum pa yan chad bzhugs/ (bā)pa la de'i 'jug rdzogs pa dang*/ sdud pa'i lde mig kha che shākya shris mdzad pa/ rdo rje gcod pa'i rgya cher 'grel dbu ma'i lugs su bkral ba baṃ po lnga pa slob dpon ka ma la shi las mdzad nam mkha' skyong gi 'gyur/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa bdun brgya pa'i rgya cher 'grel slob dpon bhi ma la mi tras mdzad pa/ shes rab snying po'i rgya cher 'grel bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa sgro rin che dang*/ ban de nam mkha'i 'gyur/ shes rab snying po'i 'grel pa don gyi sgron ma/ shes rab snying po'i bka' 'grel slob dpon ka ma la shi las mdzad pa/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi 'gyur/ shes rab snying po'i 'grel pa don bcus gsal bar ston pa slob dpon pra shaskra se nas mdzad pa/ shes rab snying po'i 'grel pa jo bo rjes mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/

shes snying gi rgya cher 'grel pa cig /shes snying gi 'grel pa slob dpon ye shes bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ shes snying gi 'grel pa don gsal ba'i sgrol ma shi ri sing has mdzad pa/ shes rab snying po'i 'grel pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ glan chung gi 'gyur/ shes snying gi don yongs su shes par byed pa bi ma ha dza nas mdzad pa/ seng ge rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ pha rol tu phyin pa bsdus pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dgu pa dang*/ de'i rgya cher 'grel pa gnyis kam pa las mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin ma don bsdus sgron ma mar me mdzad ye shes kyi mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ yul lta ba'i cha ston pa/ theg pa chen po dbu ma'i phyogs la/ (mā)pa la dbu ma bstod tshogs kyi gnas chen po brgyad la bstod pa/ chos kyi dbyings su bstod pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ bsam gyis mi khyab par bstod pa/ dpe med par bstod pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ 'jig rten las 'das par bstod pa/ bstod pa las 'das par bstod pa/ don dam par bstod pa ye shes rdo rje'i 'gyur/ bla na med par bstod pa dge slong shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ sku gsum la bstod pa ban de nyi ma grags kyi 'gyur/ de'i rang 'grel rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ phyag 'tshal ba'i bstod pa/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i bstod pa/ sems kyi rdo rje mdzad pa bstod pa dge slong shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ sems mgu bar bya ba'i tshigs su bcad pa/ chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur rnams slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ bstod tshogs 'di tshogs dkar chag na 'dug ste/ po ti na chad 'dug dbu ma rtsa ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa rab tu byed pa nyi shu rtsa bdun shu lo kha brgya bzhi bcu rtsa dgu baṃ po gcig pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ klu'i rgyal mtshan dang pa tshab kyi 'gyur/

de'i rang 'grel ga las 'jigs med nyis stong tshig bzhi brgya pa klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ dbu ma rtsa ba'i 'grel pa bhud dha pa li ta sum stong bam po bcu pa slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis mdzad pa klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ dbu ma rtsa ba'i 'grel pa slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'i rab tu byed pa nyi shu pa'i 'grel pa yan chad pa tshab kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (tsā)pa la de'i 'jug dang*/ dbu ma rtsa ba'i sgron me sho lo ka drug stong bam po nyi shu slob dpon legs ldan 'byed kyis mdzad pa klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi bsgyur ba dang*/ de'i 'grel bshad spyan ras gzigs brtul zhugs kyis mdzad pa'i stod bam po lnga pa yan chad bzhugs/ (tsha dza wa)rnams la de'i 'jug bam po brgya bcu pa klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba dang*/ dbu ma rin po che'i sgron ma'i stod drang ba'i don gyi kun rdzob kyi shes pa yan chad bzhugs/ (zhā)pa la de'i 'jug yongs su rdzogs pa brtson 'grus seng ge dang tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ rig pa drug bcu pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ pa tshab nyi ma grags kyi 'gyur/ rig pa drug bcu pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa bakṣu na kṣa'i 'gyur/ stong nyid bdun bcu pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa gzhon nu mchog gi 'gyur/ de'i rang 'grel brda sprod pa chen po slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ zhib mo rnam par 'thag pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ grags 'byor shes rab kyi 'gyur/ de'i rang 'grel gzhon nu mchog gi 'gyur/ theg chen nyi shu pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ yi ge brgya pa rtsa 'grel klu grub kyis mdzad pa gnyis grags 'byor shes rab kyi 'gyur/ de kho na nyid rnam par 'byed pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa ye shes 'byung ga gnas zla ba'i rang 'gyur/ skye med rin po che'i mdzod slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/

pu rgya kirti'i 'gyur/ rang bzhin gsum la 'jug pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa zla ba grags pa'i rang 'gyur/ ma rtogs pa rtogs par byed pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa grags 'byor shes rab kyi 'gyur/ dbu ma rten 'brel snying po rtsa 'grel klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa ye shes sde lags pa'i 'gyur/ rab tu byed pa lag pa'i tshad rtsa 'grel/ 'khrul pa bzlog pa'i rim pa/ rig pa gtan tshigs bsgrub pa/ dpal rtsegs kyi 'gyur/ 'khrul pa 'joms pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ cha shas kyi yan lag rtsa 'grel gnyis rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ ye shes snying po kun las btus pa dang lnga 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa/ ye shes snying po kun las btus pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon byang chub snying po mdzad pa/ sku gsum du 'jug pa'i sgo slob dpon klu'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ de'i 'grel pa slob dpon ye shes zla bas mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ dbu ma lugs kyi snying po birya ka ras mdzad pa dpal rtsegs rakṣi ta'i 'gyur/ dbu ma rin po che'i phreng ba slob dpon tsan tra ha ri las mdzad pa/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po'i 'gyur/ rtog ge tho ba slob dpon rgyal ba bzang pos mdzad pa/ tshad ma rnams 'joms kyi 'grel pa paṇḍi ta lakṣi ka ras mdzad pa/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ phung po lnga pa slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ srid pa 'pho ba slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa paṇḍi ta byams pa mgon pos mdzad pa gzhon nu zla ba'i rang 'gyur/ dbu ma shes rab la 'jug pa slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa/ rnam pa med pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa paṇḍi ta dga' ba'i dpal gyis mdzad pa/ lta ba tha dad pa rnam par phye ba slob dpon dbu ma seng ges mdzad pa chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ dbu ma'i don bsdus slob dpon legs ldan 'byed kyis mdzad pa/

dbu ma rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba/ slob dpon nag po bas mdzad pa/ snang ba'i phreng ba zhes bya ba'i rab du byed pa/ slob dpon kam pa las mdzad pa shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ rnal 'byor spyod pa bzhi brgya pa rab tu byed pa bcu drug pa 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa dang*/ de'i 'grel pa slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa pa tshab nyi ma grags kyis bsgyur ba'i stod rnams bzhugs/ (zā)pa la de'i 'jug dang*/ dza ya a nan tas mdzad pa'i 'grel bshad kyi stod yan chad bzhugs/ ('ā)pa la de'i 'jug rdzogs pa dang*/ bden gnyis rtsa 'grel slob dpon ye shes snying pos mdzad pa/ bden gnyis kyi bka' 'grel slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa bam po gnyis pa yan chad bzhugs/ (yā)pa la de'i 'jug rdzogs pa dang*/ dbu ma rgyan rtsa 'grel slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa ye shes rdo rje'i 'gyur/ dbu ma rgyan gyi bka' 'grel sho lo ka sum brgya bam po bzhi pa slob dpon ka ma la shi las mdzad pa/ ye shes rdo rje'i 'gyur/ dbu ma brgyan gyi man ngag slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa shākya 'od dang 'o ru lo tsā ba'i 'gyur/ dbu ma snang ba ka ma la shi las mdzad pa/ dpal rtsegs kyi 'gyur/ dbu ma snying po'i tshig le'ur byas pa bcu gcig pa dang*/ de'i 'grel pa rtog ge la 'bar ba le'u bcu gcig pa slob dpon legs ldan byed kyis mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur gyi bam po dgu pa yan chad bzhugs/ (rā)pa la de'i 'jug rdzogs pa dang*/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med par grub pa dpal rtsegs kyi 'gyur/ de kho na nyid snang ba'i rab tu byed pa gnyis ka ma la shi las mdzad pa/ de kho na nyid la 'jug pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon dpal sbas kyis mdzad pa/ bde gshegs gzhung gi rab dbye'i tshig le'ur byas pa sho lo ka brgyad pa 'dze ta ri dgra las rnam par rgyal bas mdzad pa shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ de'i rang 'grel shes rab grags kyi bsgyur ba/

bsgom pa'i rim pa'i phyogs la/ bsgom pa'i rim pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rims kyis 'jug pa'i bsgom rim bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa/ ye shes rdo rje'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs/ (lā)pa la bsgom rims dang po dang*/ bar pa/ tha ma/ rims kyis 'jug pa'i bsgom rims dang bzhi/ slob dpon ka ma la shi las mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur ro// bsgom pa'i lam ye shes snying pos mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor sgom pa 'jug pa las mi gtsang ba bsgom pa/ slob dpon dge ba'i go chas mdzad pa 'gyur snying mi rtag pa bsgom pa'i bstan bcos slob dpon nag po zhabs kyis mdzad pa dang*/ lus yongs su spyad pa'i bsgom rim dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ pha rol du phyin pa'i theg pa'i rim pa bsgom pa slob dpon ye shes grags pas mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i man ngag rnal 'byor pa bzhi'i bshad pa dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i man ngag bsdus pa gnyis rad na a ka ra shan ti bas mdzad pa 'gos kyi 'gyur/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa bla na med pa bsgom pa slob dpon ma ha ma tis mdzad pa chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i don mdor bsdus pa slob dpon ye shes bzang pos mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ rnal 'byor la 'jug pa slob dpon chos kyi bzang pos mdzad pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mdo tsam gdam ngag du bya ba mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor gyi bden pa slob dpon byang chub bzang pos mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i ting nge 'dzin tshogs kyi le'u dang*/ ting nge 'dzin tshogs kyi le'u slob dpon nag po pas mdzad pa gnyis chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ ting nge 'dzin tshogs kyi le'u mar me mdzad ye shes kyi mdzad pa shākya blo gros kyi 'gyur/ bsam gtan gyi chos drug rnam par bzhag pa a ba dhu ti pas mdzad pa/
